title: Fokus Transformasi BKI Memperkuat Daya Saing dan Ekspansi Global Bersama IDSurvey di Era Danantara
full_text:
# Fokus Transformasi BKI Memperkuat Daya Saing dan Ekspansi Global Bersama IDSurvey di Era Danantara

BKI mempercepat transformasi bersama IDSurvey dan Danantara guna memperkuat daya saing, ekspansi global, serta pertumbuhan bisnis berkelanjutan.

JAKARTA – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI terus mempercepat transformasi bisnis dan penguatan daya saing seiring dengan penguatan ekosistem BUMN melalui Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (Danantara). Transformasi yang telah berjalan sebelumnya kini semakin mudah untuk dijalankan melalui penyelarasan strategi, penguatan tata kelola, serta implementasi sejumlah program prioritas yang berorientasi pada pertumbuhan jangka panjang dan penciptaan nilai.

Sebagai bagian dari IDSurvey, BKI sebelumnya telah melakukan berbagai inisiatif transformasi untuk meningkatkan daya saing, memperkuat kapabilitas teknis, dan meningkatkan kualitas layanan. Kehadiran Danantara menjadi momentum untuk melanjutkan kesinambungan transformasi tersebut dengan arah strategis yang lebih terintegrasi.

Penguatan arah transformasi ini tercermin dalam penyusunan Rencana Jangka Panjang Perusahaan (RJPP) 2026–2030 yang selaras dengan strategi holding. BKI juga menetapkan sejumlah program strategis sebagai prioritas. Dengan pendekatan ini, transformasi BKI tidak hanya berfokus pada perbaikan internal, tetapi juga diarahkan untuk membuka peluang pertumbuhan baru serta memperkuat posisi perusahaan di tingkat nasional dan global.

Dalam rangka mempercepat target tersebut, BKI menjalankan tiga "Iconic Moves" strategis.
Pertama, BKI menargetkan menjadi anggota International Association of Classification Societies (IACS) untuk meningkatkan pengakuan internasional, memperkuat kapabilitas teknis, dan memperluas daya saing di pasar global. Kedua, BKI memanfaatkan teknologi citra satelit resolusi tinggi untuk mengembangkan layanan berbasis geospasial sekaligus memperluas portofolio bisnis perusahaan.
Ketiga, BKI menjalankan strategi "Go Global" dengan rencana pembukaan kantor cabang di Tiongkok sebagai langkah untuk memperluas akses pasar internasional dan memperkuat jejak BKI di pasar global.Sejalan dengan itu, BKI juga menetapkan "Map Production Center" sebagai Program Unggulan.

Program ini mendukung agenda strategis Pemerintah dalam penyediaan layanan pemetaan dan informasi geospasial untuk pembangunan nasional.Keberhasilan transformasi tidak hanya diukur dari jumlah program yang dijalankan, tetapi juga dari dampak nyata terhadap kinerja dan daya saing perusahaan. Untuk itu, BKI memperkuat tata kelola transformasi melalui penetapan Key Operational Metrics serta monitoring dan evaluasi berkala terhadap implementasi program strategis kedepan, BKI akan terus mempercepat transformasi dengan mengoptimalkan kekuatan yang telah dibangun.

Penguatan bisnis inti, pengembangan teknologi, digitalisasi proses, serta ekspansi ke pasar internasional akan menjadi pilar utama strategi perusahaan dalam menghadapi dinamika industri dan menangkap peluang pertumbuhan baru.

Dengan dukungan penguatan ekosistem BUMN melalui Danantara dan sinergi strategi bersama IDSurvey, BKI optimistis dapat melanjutkan transformasi dengan fondasi yang lebih kuat dan arah yang semakin fokus. Langkah ini menjadi bagian dari komitmen BKI untuk tumbuh sebagai perusahaan yang adaptif, kompetitif, dan mampu memberikan kontribusi lebih besar bagi industri nasional dan perekonomian Indonesia.

title: Determination of Material Sustainability Topics
full_text:
# ESG > Governance > Sustainability Topics: Determination of Material Sustainability Topics

## Determination of Material Sustainability Topics

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) conducts a materiality assessment as part of its commitment to ensuring that the sustainability issues managed by the Company remain relevant to business developments, stakeholder expectations, and changes in the external environment.

The material sustainability topics determination process is conducted periodically and reviewed annually to ensure the relevance of sustainability issues with the Company’s strategy, emerging risks and opportunities, and stakeholder expectations. Through this approach, PT BKI (Persero) ensures that economic, environmental, and social aspects that significantly influence the Company’s sustainability and stakeholders are identified and managed effectively.

### Material Sustainability Topics Determination Process

In determining material sustainability topics, PT BKI (Persero) considers various factors, including the Company’s internal and external context, business strategy, sustainability policies, and relevant risks and opportunities associated with its operational activities.

The identification process of material sustainability topics consists of the following stages:

- Identification of internal and external contexts, including industry developments, regulations, Company strategy, and relevant sustainability issues;

- Identification of actual and potential impacts, including impacts on the Company and external stakeholders;

- Assessment of impact significance, considering the magnitude of impacts on the Company and the level of importance of issues to stakeholders;

- Prioritization of material sustainability topics based on assessment results and stakeholder inputs; and

- Review and approval by management responsible for the Company’s sustainability matters.

### Stakeholder Engagement

PT BKI (Persero) involves both internal and external stakeholders in the material sustainability topics determination process to obtain a comprehensive understanding of sustainability issues that are considered significant.

Stakeholder engagement is conducted by gathering input from various stakeholder groups, including management, employees, customers, business partners, regulators, and other relevant parties. The feedback obtained serves as one of the key considerations in determining sustainability priorities and issues requiring further attention by the Company.

### Integration with Enterprise Risk Management

The results of the material sustainability topics determination process serve as one of the considerations in managing the Company’s sustainability-related risks and opportunities. Identified material topics are used as references in understanding issues that may influence the achievement of the Company’s strategic objectives.

Through the integration of materiality assessment results with the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, PT BKI (Persero) strengthens its risk management approach by incorporating sustainability considerations into risk identification, evaluation, monitoring, and strategic decision-making processes.

This approach enables the Company to create long-term value through more comprehensive management of sustainability-related risks and opportunities while remaining aligned with stakeholder expectations.

title: BKI Sustains Strong Growth in 2025, Strengthening Business Fundamentals with IDSurvey and Danantara
full_text:
# BKI Sustains Strong Growth in 2025, Strengthening Business Fundamentals with IDSurvey and Danantara

BKI recorded strong financial growth in 2025, driven by improved operational efficiency and strengthened business fundamentals as it advanced its corporate transformation within Indonesia's evolving SOE ecosystem under Danantara.

Jakarta, July 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) delivered strong financial performance in 2025 while advancing its corporate transformation amid the restructuring of Indonesia's State-Owned Enterprise (SOE) ecosystem through the Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (Danantara).

The milestone marks an important phase in BKI's transformation, reinforcing its business fundamentals, improving operational efficiency, and creating greater long-term value for shareholders and stakeholders.

The strengthening of the SOE ecosystem through Danantara also provides BKI with greater strategic focus as an independent business entity. With a more streamlined governance structure, the company is sharpening its focus on its core strengths in ship classification and statutory services while expanding its capabilities across the TICCS (Testing, Inspection, Certification, Consultancy, Classification, and Statutory) sector.

This strategic direction has translated into stronger operational performance and sustained business growth throughout 2025, despite the ongoing transformation of the national SOE landscape.

For the full year, BKI recorded revenue of IDR 1.5 trillion, representing a 13.6% year-on-year increase from IDR 1.3 trillion in 2024. Core operating profit grew 27.67%, reflecting continued improvements in operational efficiency and profitability.

The company's operating profit margin also strengthened from 19.44% to 21.84%, while cash flow from operating activities increased by 51.76%, highlighting BKI's growing ability to generate healthy cash flow from its core operations.

As the company continues to strengthen its independent business development strategy, BKI has further enhanced resource utilization and operational efficiency. Its operating cash efficiency ratio improved from 15.38% to 20.54%, demonstrating greater value creation from every rupiah of revenue while reinforcing overall operational performance.

These achievements provide a solid foundation for BKI to accelerate its transformation within Indonesia's evolving SOE ecosystem. Supported by stronger business fundamentals and a sharper strategic direction, the company is well positioned to expand into high-growth sectors and capture long-term business opportunities.

Looking ahead, BKI will continue to strengthen its core business while pursuing new opportunities in the green economy, industrial digitalisation, and international markets. Drawing on the expertise and synergies developed within the IDSurvey ecosystem, the company aims to further enhance its competitiveness and deliver sustainable growth.

As Indonesia's SOE landscape continues to evolve through Danantara, BKI remains committed to advancing with a more focused organisation, a stronger strategic direction, and enhanced capabilities. Building on this momentum, the company is confident in its ability to deliver sustained business growth, contribute to national industrial development, and create lasting value for Indonesia.

title: BKI Strengthens Industry Trust in Verifying and Certifying Indonesian Vessels
full_text:
# BKI Strengthens Industry Trust in Verifying and Certifying Indonesian Vessels

PT BKI (Persero) strengthened its mandate as a recognized organization for surveying and certifying Indonesian-flagged vessels through a renewed cooperation agreement with the Directorate General of Sea Transportation.

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) has further strengthened its role as a trusted authority for the survey, verification, and statutory certification of Indonesian-flagged vessels following the signing of a Cooperation Agreement (Perjanjian Kerja Sama/PKS) with the Directorate General of Sea Transportation, Ministry of Transportation.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-01-13 at 11.48.35 (1).jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_01_13_at_11_48_35_1_4d76962ef6.jpeg)

The agreement was signed on January 12, 2026, at the Ministry of Transportation Headquarters in Jakarta by the Director General of Sea Transportation, Muhammad Masyhud, and BKI President Director, R. Benny Susanto. The cooperation reaffirms the government’s delegation of authority to BKI to conduct inspections, testing, surveys, verification, and statutory certification of Indonesian-flagged ships in accordance with prevailing laws and international standards.
Benny Susanto emphasized BKI’s continued commitment to supporting the government in strengthening shipping safety and improving service quality across the national maritime sector. He expressed confidence that the extension of this cooperation would deliver tangible benefits for the nation, particularly in enhancing vessel safety and ensuring reliable services for all maritime stakeholders.
He also noted that the collaboration is expected to foster stronger communication and synergy among regulators, classification societies, shipowners, shipping companies, and seafarers to build a shipping safety system that is reliable, efficient, and globally competitive.
Meanwhile, Director General Muhammad Masyhud reaffirmed the Ministry of Transportation’s commitment to strengthening national maritime safety governance through professional, transparent, and accountable partnerships. He explained that in 2026, the government officially extended BKI’s mandate as a recognized organization authorized to carry out statutory surveys and certification on behalf of the state for Indonesian-flagged vessels.
Masyhud highlighted BKI’s strategic role in supporting government oversight, particularly for Indonesian ships operating on international routes. He expressed hope that this cooperation would ensure consistent compliance with international safety standards and help maintain Indonesia’s position on the Tokyo MoU White List, thereby strengthening global confidence in the country’s maritime safety regime.
The cooperation is implemented in accordance with Law No. 17 of 2008 on Shipping, which requires vessels of certain types and sizes to be classified by a recognized classification body, and aligns with the implementation of the IMO Recognized Organization (RO) Code as stipulated under Maritime Safety Committee resolutions.
Through this strengthened partnership, BKI and the Directorate General of Sea Transportation reaffirm their shared commitment to enhancing ship quality, safeguarding maritime safety, and supporting the sustainable growth of Indonesia’s shipping industry.

title: Penentuan Topik Material Keberlanjutan

# ESG > Governance > Topik Materialitas: Penentuan Topik Material Keberlanjutan

## Penentuan Topik Material Keberlanjutan

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) melakukan penilaian materialitas sebagai bagian dari komitmen untuk memastikan bahwa isu keberlanjutan yang dikelola Perusahaan tetap relevan dengan perkembangan bisnis, ekspektasi pemangku kepentingan, serta perubahan lingkungan eksternal.

Proses penentuan topik material dilakukan secara berkala dan ditinjau secara tahunan untuk memastikan kesesuaian isu keberlanjutan dengan strategi Perusahaan, risiko dan peluang yang berkembang, serta kebutuhan pemangku kepentingan. Melalui pendekatan ini, PT BKI (Persero) memastikan bahwa aspek ekonomi, lingkungan, dan sosial yang memiliki pengaruh signifikan terhadap keberlanjutan Perusahaan maupun pemangku kepentingan dapat teridentifikasi dan dikelola secara efektif.

### Proses Penentuan Topik Material

Dalam melakukan penentuan topik material keberlanjutan, PT BKI (Persero) mempertimbangkan berbagai faktor, termasuk konteks internal dan eksternal Perusahaan, strategi bisnis, kebijakan keberlanjutan, serta risiko dan peluang yang relevan dengan kegiatan operasional.

Proses identifikasi topik material dilakukan melalui beberapa tahapan, yaitu:

- Identifikasi konteks internal dan eksternal, termasuk perkembangan industri, regulasi, strategi Perusahaan, serta isu keberlanjutan yang relevan;

- Identifikasi dampak aktual dan potensial, baik dampak terhadap Perusahaan maupun terhadap pemangku kepentingan;

- Penilaian tingkat signifikansi dampak, dengan mempertimbangkan besarnya dampak terhadap Perusahaan serta tingkat kepentingan isu bagi pemangku kepentingan;

- Penentuan prioritas topik material berdasarkan hasil penilaian dan masukan dari pemangku kepentingan; dan

- Review dan persetujuan oleh manajemen yang bertanggung jawab terhadap aspek keberlanjutan Perusahaan.

### Pelibatan Pemangku Kepentingan

PT BKI (Persero) melibatkan pemangku kepentingan internal maupun eksternal dalam proses penentuan topik material untuk memperoleh pemahaman yang komprehensif mengenai isu-isu keberlanjutan yang memiliki tingkat kepentingan tinggi.

Pelibatan tersebut dilakukan melalui pengumpulan masukan dari berbagai kelompok pemangku kepentingan, termasuk manajemen, karyawan, pelanggan, mitra kerja, regulator, dan pihak terkait lainnya. Masukan yang diperoleh menjadi salah satu dasar dalam menentukan prioritas isu keberlanjutan yang perlu menjadi perhatian Perusahaan.

### Integrasi dengan Manajemen Risiko Perusahaan

Hasil penentuan topik material keberlanjutan menjadi salah satu pertimbangan dalam pengelolaan risiko dan peluang keberlanjutan Perusahaan. Topik material yang telah teridentifikasi digunakan sebagai referensi dalam memahami isu-isu yang berpotensi memengaruhi pencapaian tujuan strategis Perusahaan.

Melalui integrasi antara hasil materiality assessment dan kerangka Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), PT BKI (Persero) memperkuat pendekatan pengelolaan risiko dengan mempertimbangkan aspek keberlanjutan dalam proses identifikasi, evaluasi, pemantauan, dan pengambilan keputusan strategis. Pendekatan ini mendukung Perusahaan dalam menciptakan nilai jangka panjang melalui pengelolaan risiko dan peluang yang lebih komprehensif serta selaras dengan kebutuhan pemangku kepentingan.

title: BKI and PLN Indonesia Power Collaborate to Advance Sustainable Energy Programs

# BKI and PLN Indonesia Power Collaborate to Advance Sustainable Energy Programs

BKI and PLN Indonesia Power signed an MoU to explore strategic collaboration focused on technical certification, asset management, and decarbonization for Indonesia's power infrastructure.

Jakarta, April 27, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with PT PLN Indonesia Power (PLN-IP) to explore strategic collaboration across a range of technical services, including certification, inspection, non-destructive testing, laboratory services, surveys, engineering, and decarbonisation initiatives. The signing, held at PLN Indonesia Power’s office in Jakarta, marks an initial step toward strengthening cooperation to support safe, reliable, and sustainable power generation.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-27 at 17.17.07.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_04_27_at_17_17_07_b3525a7f24.jpeg)

The MoU establishes a framework for both parties to assess potential collaboration opportunities, including technical support and regulatory compliance, while identifying associated benefits, risks, and implementation pathways for future initiatives.

The agreement was signed in the presence of BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto, accompanied by Director of Commercial Business Operations Erwin Ernanto Hoesni and VP of CoE Energy R. Sapto Agung Pramusinto. PLN Indonesia Power was represented by its President Director, Bernadus Sudarmanta, along with senior management.

During the signing, R. Benny Susanto reaffirmed BKI’s commitment as a strategic technical partner. "BKI is prepared to leverage its deep technical expertise, independence, and competence to ensure that PLN Indonesia Power’s facilities—from operations to maintenance—adhere to the highest international standards for safety, quality, and regulatory compliance," Susanto stated.

Bernadus Sudarmanta, President Director of PT PLN Indonesia Power, highlighted the evolving role of BKI. He noted that BKI is now a vital partner in the broader energy sector, moving beyond its traditional maritime roots. This shift is crucial for PLN-IP, which manages over 400 generating units providing approximately 25% of the nation’s electricity.

"BKI offers the sophisticated inspection and certification capabilities essential to our business transformation and asset management," said Sudarmanta. "As we scale our renewable energy projects and navigate complex operational dynamics, this collaboration is a strategic step toward strengthening our long-term performance and sustainability."

A key focus of the collaboration is decarbonisation, with BKI expected to provide engineering solutions and feasibility studies to support the transition toward more environmentally sustainable power generation systems. This aligns with broader efforts to achieve Net Zero Emissions and strengthen the resilience of Indonesia’s energy sector.

Through this partnership, BKI reinforces its role as a trusted provider of testing, inspection, certification, and statutory services, supporting risk mitigation, operational reliability, and national energy security.

## HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY

As an integral part of the national and global business ecosystem, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (BKI) (Persero) fully recognizes that respect for, protection of, and fulfillment of Human Rights (HR) are the fundamental pillars of sustainable and ethical business operations. This policy serves as a formal commitment and guiding framework for all employees of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) and business partners to ensure that all activities and decisions consistently uphold universal human rights values. Therefore, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) is committed to:

Upholding Human Rights by complying with applicable national laws and regulations, including the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, Law No. 39 of 1999 on Human Rights, Law No. 26 of 2000 on the Human Rights Court, as well as other relevant regulations. This commitment is further reinforced by the application of international standards such as the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR), the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP), the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR), the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (ICESCR), and other applicable global human rights instruments. The company is committed to ensuring its operations do not violate or contribute to human rights violations in any form.

3. Respect the right of all employees of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) to form and join labor unions or workers’ representatives of their choice, as well as the right to engage in collective bargaining peacefully, without fear of retaliation, discrimination, or intimidation.

1. Ensuring equal opportunity for all employees of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) and prohibiting all forms of discrimination regardless of ethnicity, religion, race, skin color, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, political views, disability status, or other background in the recruitment, placement, compensation, training, promotion, and termination of employment processes.
2. Requiring all business partners, including suppliers, contractors, and other third parties, to understand, accept, and implement human rights standards equivalent to those set forth in this policy.
3. Establish a clear and confidential escalation process for reporting incidents of violations and ensure protection for whistleblowers against any form of retaliation.
4. Any employee of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) found to have committed a human rights violation will be subject to firm corrective or disciplinary action in accordance with the Company’s regulations and applicable laws and regulations.

title: Efisiensi Energi untuk Kapal
full_text:
# Efisiensi Energi untuk Kapal

### Efisiensi Energi untuk Kapal

#### Indikator Intensitas Karbon (CII)

Peringkat tahunan A–E berdasarkan data DCS IMO: pelaporan ≤ 3 bulan; SoC ≤ 5 bulan; rencana korektif jika peringkat E (1 tahun) atau D (3 tahun berturut-turut).

#### Untuk Kapal Baru: EEDI

EEDI mendorong kapal baru yang lebih efisien dan rendah emisi untuk ≥ 400 GT.

#### Untuk Kapal yang Ada: EEXI

Prinsip-prinsip yang mirip EEDI berlaku untuk kapal yang beroperasi di atas 400 GT, memastikan armada memenuhi standar iklim.

#### Komitmen Global untuk Masa Depan yang Lebih Ramah Lingkungan

Sejalan dengan SDG 13, IMO telah menerapkan langkah-langkah wajib untuk mengurangi emisi gas rumah kaca dari pelayaran melalui MARPOL Lampiran VI. Sebagai Organisasi yang Diakui (RO), BKI membantu armada Anda mematuhi aturan, efisien, dan kompetitif.

Efisiensi Energi untuk Kapal

#### Indeks Desain Efisiensi Energi (EEDI)

Standar efisiensi energi untuk kapal baru ≥ 400 GT, yang beroperasi pada tahap perancangan dan selama uji coba laut sebelum diterbitkan oleh IEEC.

#### Indeks Efisiensi Energi untuk Kapal Eksisting (EEXI)

Implementasi prinsip efisiensi pada kapal yang ada ≥ 400 GT. Termasuk solusi seperti SHAPOLI/EPL dan penerbitan ulang IEEC.

#### Rencana Manajemen Efisiensi Energi Kapal (SEEMP)

Bagian I, II (IMO DCS), dan III (CII): perencanaan, pengumpulan data konsumsi bahan bakar, dan peningkatan kinerja berkelanjutan.

- Verifikasi Berkas Teknis EEDI (Pendahuluan & Akhir)

- Persetujuan EEXI & Penerbitan Ulang IEEC

- Perjanjian SEEMP Bagian I, II, dan III

- Penerbitan Konfirmasi Kepatuhan (CoC) untuk SEEMP

- Verifikasi Data Bahan Bakar & SoC Tahunan untuk IMO DCS

- Perhitungan & verifikasi CII tahunan

- Persetujuan Rencana Tindakan Korektif untuk peringkat D/E

Layanan

#### Verifikasi Pendahuluan

Verifikasi EEDI pada tahap perancangan sebelum konstruksi.

#### Verifikasi Akhir

Survei selama uji coba laut untuk mengonfirmasi nilai EEDI & penerbitan IEEC.

#### Penilaian Kepatuhan

Bandingkan EEXI yang Dicapai vs. yang Diperlukan; ambil tindakan jika tidak terpenuhi.

A

#### Tindakan penanggulangan

Implementasi SHAPOLI/EPL atau solusi lainnya, dengan panduan & persetujuan dari BKI.

B

#### Verifikasi & Sertifikasi

Verifikasi pada survei IAPP pertama ≥ 1 Jan 2023, kemudian terbitkan kembali IEEC.

C

#### Langkah Teknis: EEDI & EEXI

Fokus pada desain kapal & perlengkapan untuk memenuhi tingkat efisiensi minimum.

Lampiran VI MARPOL

#### Dasar & Pemantauan

Bagian I

Wajib sejak 2013 untuk semua kapal ≥ 400 GT. Rencana untuk meningkatkan efisiensi energi kapal.

#### Pengumpulan Data

Bagian II (IMO DCS)

Untuk kapal ≥ 5.000 GT. Metodologi pengumpulan dan pelaporan konsumsi bahan bakar tahunan.

#### Kinerja & Peningkatan

Bagian III (CII)

Rencana untuk mencapai peringkat CII (A–E): metodologi perhitungan, rencana 3 tahun, dan prosedur evaluasi mandiri.

#### Langkah Operasional: SEEMP, DCS & CII

Manajemen & pemantauan operasi kapal untuk peningkatan kinerja secara berkelanjutan.

Manajemen Energi Kapal

BKI menyediakan layanan hukum lengkap untuk memastikan setiap tenggat waktu dan persyaratan terpenuhi dengan baik.

# ESG > Social > Accessible Communication Channels: OPEN COMMUNICATION CHANNELS

## OPEN COMMUNICATION CHANNELS

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) is committed to building a responsive and transparent relationship with customers through the provision of various easily accessible communication channels, to ensure that every customer input, question, or complaint can be received, followed up, and resolved in a timely manner. This commitment is demonstrated through the following initiatives:

### Channels for Submitting Customer Input and Complaints

As a form of openness in receiving customer feedback, PT BKI (Persero) provides a dedicated email address that customers can use to submit input or complaints to the Company. In addition, the Company also provides a dedicated phone line to ensure that every customer input can be received and followed up directly by the relevant work team. For customers who require face-to-face service, PT BKI (Persero) also provides in-person customer service at the Head Office, where every question is answered directly by the Corporate Marketing Division.

### Process of Integrating Customer Feedback into Product and Service Development

To ensure that customer feedback is genuinely utilized as material for continuous improvement, PT BKI (Persero) regularly conducts customer satisfaction surveys to capture perception, experience, and the level of satisfaction with the services provided. The results of this survey serve as a service evaluation instrument used to identify areas for improvement in the Company's future service planning and development.

### Confirmation of Receipt of Customer Complaints

Every complaint submitted by a customer to PT BKI (Persero), whether through official correspondence, email, or telephone, is recorded, verified, and followed up through an initial verification process to ensure appropriate handling. This mechanism guarantees that every report received obtains confirmation of receipt and is handled in accordance with applicable procedures.

### Transparency of Complaint Resolution Timeframes

The complaint-handling process at PT BKI (Persero) is carried out transparently. Reports that have been verified and can be handled directly will be responded to by the receiving work unit. Meanwhile, complaints that require cross-unit coordination will be documented through a Customer Complaint Action Request (CCAR) and forwarded to the relevant work unit, with a copy to the Corporate Marketing Division. As part of a periodic control and evaluation mechanism, PT BKI (Persero) also records every reported complaint in a Customer Complaint Log Book, to ensure that customers receive timely updates on the status of complaint handling.

To make it easier for customers to submit questions, input, or complaints, the following is the official contact information of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero):

title: BKI Raih Statement of Compliance (SoC to IACS QSCS), Tegaskan Komitmen Pemenuhan Standar Mutu Internasional Jasa Klasifikasi & Statutoria
full_text:
# BKI Raih Statement of Compliance (SoC to IACS QSCS), Tegaskan Komitmen Pemenuhan Standar Mutu Internasional Jasa Klasifikasi & Statutoria

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI memperoleh Statement of Compliance (SoC) sistem manajemen mutu pada 26 Desember 2025 sebagai bukti pemenuhan standar internasional International Association of Classification Societies (IACS).

Jakarta, 26 Desember 2025 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI memperoleh Statement of Compliance (SOC) atas sistem manajemen mutunya setelah berhasil menyelesaikan kegiatan audit oleh SGS China pada 26 Desember 2025. Pengakuan ini diberikan sebagai bukti bahwa BKI telah memenuhi standar internasional yang ditetapkan oleh International Association of Classification Societies (IACS) dalam penyelenggaraan jasa klasifikasi dan statutoria.

Statement of Compliance (SoC) merupakan pernyataan resmi atas kepatuhan suatu organisasi terhadap standar operasional yang berlaku. Bagi BKI, SoC ini diperoleh setelah perusahaan dinyatakan telah menyelesaikan audit menyeluruh atas sistem manajemen mutu sesuai skema International Association of Classification Societies Quality System Certification Scheme (IACS QSCS).

Audit mencakup pemeriksaan terhadap penerapan sistem manajemen mutu di kantor pusat dan kantor cabang (Office Audit), serta penilaian pelaksanaan layanan pada proyek tertentu dari awal hingga akhir (Vertical Contract Audit/VCA), untuk memastikan konsistensi dan keandalan layanan.

Proses audit dilakukan oleh SGS China, lembaga sertifikasi terakreditasi dan diakui IACS, yang memastikan bahwa sistem manajemen mutu BKI telah memenuhi persyaratan yang ditetapkan secara global.
Lingkup sertifikasi IACS QSCS mencakup penilaian dan pengawasan teknis terhadap kapal serta instalasi lepas pantai bergerak untuk memastikan keselamatan dan kelayakan operasionalnya. Layanan tersebut diberikan baik kepada kapal yang baru dibangun (new building) maupun kapal yang telah beroperasi (in service). Selain itu, BKI juga menjalankan tugas tertentu atas nama administrasi bendera, yaitu membantu pemerintah dalam memastikan kapal memenuhi persyaratan keselamatan dan peraturan pelayaran internasional yang berlaku. Sertifikasi ini memastikan bahwa seluruh proses layanan BKI dijalankan secara konsisten, terukur, dan mengutamakan keselamatan.

Pencapaian SoC ini mencerminkan komitmen BKI dalam menjaga kualitas layanan dan memperkuat sistem pengawasan internal, sejalan dengan tuntutan keselamatan pelayaran dan perlindungan lingkungan maritim yang semakin tinggi.
Pengakuan internasional ini juga mempertegas langkah BKI dalam memperkuat posisinya di tingkat global serta mendukung proses menuju keanggotaan IACS. Melalui penerapan standar mutu yang diakui secara internasional, BKI menegaskan keseriusannya untuk berperan lebih aktif dalam mendukung keselamatan, keandalan, dan kemajuan industri maritim nasional.

Dengan pencapaian ini, BKI diharapkan dapat terus memberikan kontribusi nyata dalam menciptakan sistem pelayaran yang aman, andal, dan berdaya saing, sekaligus meningkatkan kepercayaan pemangku kepentingan terhadap layanan klasifikasi di tingkat nasional dan internasional.

title: BKI Updates Classification Rules to Keep Pace with Maritime Technology
full_text:
# BKI Updates Classification Rules to Keep Pace with Maritime Technology

BKI held a Technical Committee meeting in Surabaya to review and validate amendments to its Classification Rules in response to advances in maritime technology, evolving regulations, and industry needs.

Surabaya, October 7, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero), or BKI, held a Technical Committee meeting at its Main Classification Branch Office in Surabaya, followed by a technical visit to research facilities at Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS). The meeting focused on reviewing and validating amendments to BKI’s Classification Rules, ensuring they remain relevant to technological advances, evolving regulations, and the needs of the maritime industry.

![DS700363.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DS_700363_589e6a7089.jpg)
![DS700840.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DS_700840_f401bd4cc6.jpg)

Held under the theme “Embracing Technical Challenges, Creating Opportunities for Excellence,” the meeting brought together technical expertise and industry perspectives to strengthen the clarity, relevance, and consistent application of BKI’s Rules.
The meeting was attended by BKI Director of Classification Business Operations Arief Budi Permana and Indonesian Shipbuilding and Offshore Industry Association (IPERINDO) Chairperson Anita Puji Utami, who also chairs the BKI Technical Committee. The committee plays an important role in reviewing and developing classification requirements in response to advances in ship technology, evolving safety and environmental protection standards, and changes in national and international regulations.
Arief emphasised the importance of continuously updating the Rules to keep pace with technological and regulatory developments and ensure they meet industry needs.
“Technological and regulatory developments bring increasingly diverse technical challenges. For BKI, each development represents an opportunity to strengthen the quality of our Rules, ensuring they maintain a robust technical foundation, offer clarity in application, and remain relevant to industry requirements,” said Arief.
During the meeting, the committee validated several amendments covering classification and surveys, ship construction, machinery and electrical systems, safety requirements for liquefied gas carriers, and criteria for manufacturers and service suppliers.
Collaboration remains central to this process. The committee brings together regulators, academics, shipowners, shipyards, manufacturer associations, service suppliers, and industry practitioners. Their expertise and practical insights complement BKI’s technical studies and operational experience, helping ensure that the Rules reflect developments and requirements across the maritime sector.
The review process goes beyond introducing new or revised requirements. It aims to ensure that BKI’s Rules remain technically sound, clear, consistent, and practical to apply.
Through the ongoing review and collaborative development of its Classification Rules, BKI continues to support vessel safety, environmental protection, and the advancement of Indonesia’s maritime industry.

title: BKI and IDSurvey Develop Community Skills through Nglarangan Village Development Programme
full_text:
# BKI and IDSurvey Develop Community Skills through Nglarangan Village Development Programme

BKI and the IDSurvey Group have inaugurated the Nglarangan Village Development Programme in Temanggung, Central Java, with BKI contributing welding training to help residents develop practical skills and business opportunities.

Temanggung, September 23, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero), or BKI, together with the IDSurvey Group, has inaugurated the Nglarangan Village Development Programme in Tretep District, Temanggung Regency, Central Java. Through its Social and Environmental Responsibility (TJSL) programme, BKI is contributing to community skills development by providing welding training designed to equip residents with practical skills and create new business opportunities.

![DSC04203.jpg.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_04203_jpg_2f651de1bd.jpeg)
![DSC04758.jpg.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_04758_jpg_93392c788d.jpeg)

The Nglarangan Village Development Programme will run through 2028, focusing on education, environmental initiatives, and community-based enterprise development across three key areas: IDS Skill Plus, IDS EcoAssure, and IDS MSME Growth Hub. The programme began with social mapping, needs assessments, and discussions involving the Regional Development Planning, Research and Innovation Agency (Bapperida), local and village governments, and community representatives to ensure that its implementation reflects local potential and community needs.

As part of the programme, BKI and IDSurvey are drawing on their respective expertise to support the development of welding skills among local residents. The training provides practical knowledge and hands-on skills that participants can apply to develop businesses and generate income.

BKI’s Director of Institutional Affairs and Resources, R. Agus Doddy Dwisagita, who attended the inauguration, said BKI’s contribution to the programme reflects the company’s commitment to delivering benefits that can be directly applied by the community.

“We hope the skills acquired through this programme will equip the community to further develop their capabilities independently and turn them into business opportunities that align with their potential,” said Doddy.

The welding training marks an important stage in the community capacity-building process under the Nglarangan Village Development Programme. Following the implementation of priority programmes in 2026, the initiative will continue with capacity strengthening in 2027, with the goal of supporting greater community self-reliance by 2028.

Throughout the programme, residents will be encouraged to further develop and apply the skills they acquire in line with local needs and economic potential. The Nglarangan Village Development Programme also forms part of the IDSurvey Group’s broader collaboration with various stakeholders to strengthen community capacity based on needs at the village level.

As part of the IDSurvey Group, BKI contributes to the programme by applying its corporate expertise through TJSL initiatives focused on skills development and community capacity building.

title: BKI Perkuat Aturan Klasifikasi untuk Hadapi Dinamika Teknologi Maritim
full_text:
# BKI Perkuat Aturan Klasifikasi untuk Hadapi Dinamika Teknologi Maritim

BKI memperkuat Peraturan Klasifikasi melalui validasi amendemen dan kolaborasi dengan pemangku kepentingan untuk menjaga relevansi aturan terhadap perkembangan teknologi, keselamatan kapal, dan perlindungan lingkungan maritim.

Surabaya, 7 Oktober 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI menyelenggarakan Sidang Komite Teknik di Kantor Cabang Utama Klas BKI Surabaya yang dilanjutkan technical visit ke fasilitas penelitian di Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS), Surabaya. Kegiatan ini selain untuk memvalidasi amendemen Peraturan Klasifikasi atau Rules BKI, juga untuk meningkatkan kolaborasi para stakeholder di dunia maritim. Mengusung tema “Embracing Technical Challenges, Creating Opportunities for Excellence”, acara ini mempertemukan pengalaman teknis, perkembangan regulasi, dan implementasi di lapangan untuk memastikan Rules BKI tetap relevan, jelas, dan dapat diterapkan secara konsisten.

![DS700363.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DS_700363_589e6a7089.jpg)
![DS700840.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DS_700840_f401bd4cc6.jpg)

Acara Komite Teknik tersebut dihadiri Direktur Operasi Bisnis Klasifikasi BKI, Arief Budi Permana, serta Ketua Umum DPP IPERINDO, Anita Puji Utami yang juga merupakan Ketua Komite Teknik BKI. Kegiatan ini menjadi bagian utama dari proses BKI dalam meninjau dan mengembangkan ketentuan klasifikasi dengan mempertimbangkan perkembangan teknologi kapal, perubahan standar keselamatan dan perlindungan lingkungan, serta perkembangan ketentuan nasional dan internasional.
Direktur Operasi Bisnis Klasifikasi BKI, Arief Budi Permana, menilai perkembangan teknologi dan regulasi perlu diikuti dengan pembaruan Rules secara berkelanjutan agar ketentuan yang digunakan tetap relevan dengan kebutuhan industri. “Perkembangan teknologi dan regulasi membawa tantangan teknis yang semakin beragam. Bagi BKI, setiap perkembangan tersebut merupakan kesempatan untuk memperkuat kualitas Rules, sehingga tetap memiliki dasar teknis yang kuat, jelas dalam penerapan, dan relevan dengan kebutuhan industri,” ujar Arief.
Dalam Komite Teknik ini, BKI melakukan validasi terhadap sejumlah amandemen yang mencakup aspek klasifikasi dan survei, konstruksi kapal, sistem permesinan dan kelistrikan, keselamatan kapal pengangkutan gas cair, hingga persyaratan terhadap manufacturer dan service supplier.
Kolaborasi menjadi elemen penting dalam proses tersebut. Pengalaman para anggota Komite Teknik yang terdiri dari regulator, akademisi, pemilik kapal, galangan, asosiasi manufacturer, service supplier, serta praktisi industri memberikan perspektif yang melengkapi kajian teknis dan pengalaman internal BKI dalam mengembangakan industri maritim.
Pembaruan Rules bukan semata menghasilkan lebih banyak ketentuan, melainkan memastikan Rules tetap relevan, jelas, konsisten, dan memiliki dasar teknis yang dapat dipertanggungjawabkan.
Melalui pengembangan Rules yang berkelanjutan dan kolaboratif, BKI terus memperkuat kontribusinya dalam mendukung keselamatan kapal, perlindungan lingkungan, dan perkembangan industri maritim nasional.

title: BKI Supports National Ship Component Industry Through PIKKI–PT PAL Collaboration
full_text:
# BKI Supports National Ship Component Industry Through PIKKI–PT PAL Collaboration

BKI reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening Indonesia’s ship component industry by participating in a PIKKI–PT PAL business forum focused on enhancing collaboration, innovation, and supply chain competitiveness.

Bekasi, June 25, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening the competitiveness of Indonesia’s ship component industry by participating in the business forum “Optimising Supporting Industries with PT PAL Indonesia,” organised by the Indonesian Ship Component Industry Association (PIKKI) in Bekasi.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-25 at 19.10.07.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_06_25_at_19_10_07_e7d114d4b7.jpeg)

The forum brought together key stakeholders from Indonesia’s maritime sector, including PT PAL Indonesia President Director Kaharuddin Jenod, IMATAP Director Tunggul Mahardi, PIKKI Chairman Ekki Komaruddin, and representatives from the national maritime supporting industry to discuss strategies for enhancing the domestic shipbuilding supply chain.

Representing BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto, Vice President of Classification Business Operations Munir Muradi highlighted the strategic importance of Indonesia’s maritime supporting industries in strengthening the country's industrial capabilities.

"The domestic maritime supporting industry plays an indispensable role in Indonesia’s maritime ecosystem. A strong and self-reliant supply of ship components and technical services not only reinforces the national supply chain but also enhances the country’s maritime resilience and sovereignty," he said.

Munir noted that long-term competitiveness depends on continuous innovation, robust quality assurance, and the ability to meet both domestic and international market demands. He emphasised PIKKI’s role as an important platform for collaboration, advocacy, and industry development.

"By strengthening collaboration among manufacturers, classification societies such as BKI, government stakeholders, and end users including PT PAL Indonesia, we can build an ecosystem that supports greater production capacity, technology transfer, and the adoption of higher quality standards," he added.

BKI reaffirmed its commitment to supporting the industry through internationally aligned classification standards that promote transparency, efficiency, safety, and quality. Munir also highlighted the importance of complementary initiatives, including innovation incentives, workforce competency development, improved access to financing, and stronger integration into strategic supply chains.

"PIKKI has the opportunity to become a catalyst for transforming Indonesia’s ship component industry. Let us seize this momentum to strengthen collaboration and accelerate the industry's growth together," he concluded.

The forum is expected to generate practical initiatives that enhance the competitiveness of Indonesia’s ship component industry while supporting the country's long-term goal of building a stronger and more self-reliant maritime sector.

title: KEBIJAKAN HAK ASASI MANUSIA (HAM)
full_text:
# ESG > Social > Kebijakan Hak Asasi Manusia: KEBIJAKAN HAK ASASI MANUSIA (HAM)

## KEBIJAKAN HAK ASASI MANUSIA (HAM)

Sebagai bagian integral dari ekosistem bisnis nasional dan global, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (BKI) (Persero) menyadari sepenuhnya bahwa penghormatan, perlindungan, dan pemenuhan Hak Asasi Manusia (HAM) adalah landasan fundamental bagi operasional bisnis yang berkelanjutan dan etis. Kebijakan ini merupakan komitmen resmi dan panduan bagi seluruh Pegawai PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) serta mitra bisnis dalam memastikan bahwa seluruh aktivitas dan keputusan senantiasa menjunjung tinggi nilai-nilai universal HAM. Oleh karena itu, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) berkomitmen untuk:

1. Menjunjung tinggi Hak Asasi Manusia (HAM) dengan mematuhi ketentuan nasional, termasuk UUD 1945, UU No. 39 Tahun 1999 tentang HAM, UU No. 26 Tahun 2000 tentang Pengadilan HAM, serta regulasi terkait lainnya. Komitmen ini diperkuat dengan penerapan standar internasional seperti Deklarasi Universal HAM (UDHR), Prinsip-Prinsip Panduan PBB tentang Bisnis dan HAM (UNGP), ICCPR, ICESCR, dan instrumen HAM global lainnya. Perusahaan berkomitmen memastikan operasionalnya tidak melanggar maupun berkontribusi pada pelanggaran HAM dalam bentuk apa pun.
2. Secara tegas mencegah dan menghapus praktik-praktik yang melanggar hak-hak pekerja dalam seluruh rantai operasional dan pasokan, termasuk namun tidak terbatas pada:
1. Melarang keras segala bentuk perdagangan manusia dan kerja paksa. Semua pekerjaan harus dilakukan secara sukarela dan pekerja memiliki hak untuk meninggalkan pekerjaan mereka sesuai dengan pemberitahuan yang wajar.
2. Melarang penggunaan pekerja anak sesuai dengan batas usia minimum yang ditetapkan oleh peraturan perundang-undangan nasional dan standar internasional.
3. Menghormati hak seluruh Pegawai PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) untuk membentuk dan bergabung dengan serikat pekerja atau perwakilan pekerja pilihan mereka, serta hak untuk melakukan perundingan bersama secara damai, tanpa rasa takut akan pembalasan, diskriminasi, atau intimidasi.
3. Memastikan kesetaraan kesempatan bagi semua Pegawai PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) dan melarang segala bentuk diskriminasi tanpa memandang suku, agama, ras, warna kulit, jenis kelamin, orientasi seksual, status perkawinan, pandangan politik, status disabilitas, atau latar belakang lainnya dalam proses rekrutmen, penempatan, kompensasi, pelatihan, promosi, dan pemutusan hubungan kerja.
4. Mewajibkan seluruh mitra bisnis, termasuk pemasok, kontraktor, dan pihak ketiga lainnya, untuk memahami, menerima, dan menerapkan standar penghormatan HAM yang setara dengan kebijakan ini.
5. Menetapkan proses eskalasi yang jelas dan rahasia untuk melaporkan insiden pelanggaran dan memastikan perlindungan bagi pelapor dari tindakan balasan.
6. Setiap Pegawai PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) yang terbukti melakukan pelanggaran hak asasi manusia akan dikenakan tindakan korektif atau disipliner yang tegas sesuai dengan Peraturan Perusahaan serta ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

title: Layanan Negara Pesisir
full_text: # Layanan Negara Pesisir ### Layanan Negara Pesisir ### Melindungi Perairan Nasional “BKI menyediakan layanan teknis ahli untuk mendukung tanggung jawab Negara Pesisir, memastikan kapal yang beroperasi di perairan nasional aman, patuh, dan ramah lingkungan” Fokus kepulauan • ZEE & Laut Teritorial • Memprioritaskan Kepatuhan - Memastikan keselamatan navigasi untuk semua kapal. - Melindungi lingkungan laut dari polusi. - Menegakkan peraturan nasional dan internasional terhadap kapal asing yang melakukan pelayaran damai. #### 1. Verifikasi Kepatuhan untuk Kapal Asing Kapal asing yang memasuki perairan suatu negara harus mematuhi peraturan lokal yang spesifik. BKI memverifikasi bahwa kapal-kapal ini memenuhi standar yang diperlukan. - Regulasi Domestik: Verifikasi terhadap persyaratan nasional (perdagangan dalam negeri, peralatan keselamatan, penempatan awak). - Persyaratan Masuk Pelabuhan: Pemeriksaan teknis untuk standar keselamatan dan lingkungan yang spesifik bagi pelabuhan. #### 2. Dukungan Kontrol Negara Pelabuhan (PSC) Meskipun PSC merupakan fungsi pemerintah, BKI memberikan dukungan latar belakang yang krusial—memastikan kapal telah mematuhi aturan sebelum kedatangan dan merespons dengan cepat untuk menangani setiap kekurangan pada kapal-kapal yang diklasifikasi BKI. #### 3. Konsultansi Teknis untuk Infrastruktur Kemaritiman BKI menyediakan layanan penasihat teknis dan verifikasi untuk alat bantu navigasi serta pengembangan pelabuhan/terminal. - Alat Bantu Navigasi (AtoN): Verifikasi pelampung, suar, dan alat bantu navigasi lainnya. - Pengembangan Pelabuhan & Terminal: Studi teknis dan Jaminan Mutu untuk fasilitas kemaritiman. #### 4. Penasihat Perlindungan Lingkungan Panduan ahli tentang penerapan konvensi internasional seperti MARPOL di perairan nasional, termasuk strategi praktis untuk pencegahan dan penanganan polusi. #### Keunggulan BKI: Keahlian Kepulauan yang Tak Tertandingi Melayani perairan kepulauan seperti Indonesia menghadirkan tantangan yang unik. Pengalaman BKI yang tak tertandingi dalam lingkungan ini menjadikan kami mitra teknis yang ideal. Kami membantu memastikan hak-hak Negara Pesisir ditegakkan sekaligus memfasilitasi perdagangan maritim yang aman, efisien, dan sesuai peraturan bagi semua pihak. Pendekatan klasifikasi berbasis pencegahan untuk meminimalkan penahanan PSC. ### Peran dan Tanggung Jawab Negara Pesisir Dalam hukum maritim internasional, a Negara Pesisir adalah sebuah negara yang memiliki garis pantai. Ini memberikan hak tertentu dan menetapkan tanggung jawab atas Laut Teritorial (hingga 12 mil laut) dan Zona Ekonomi Eksklusif (ZEE). Sebagai lembaga klasifikasi nasional Indonesia, BKI menghadirkan keahlian mendalam tentang kepulauan untuk mendukung fungsi-fungsi nasional yang krusial ini.

title: BKI Gelar Sidang KOMTEK, Pastikan Aturan Klasifikasi Relevan bagi Industri Maritim
full_text:
# BKI Gelar Sidang KOMTEK, Pastikan Aturan Klasifikasi Relevan bagi Industri Maritim

BKI menggelar Sidang Komite Teknik untuk memvalidasi 13 Peraturan Klasifikasi yang akan berlaku Juli 2026.

Jakarta, 21 April 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI menggelar Sidang Komite Teknik (KOMTEK) di Kantor Pusat BKI. Kegiatan ini merupakan bagian dari proses pembaruan Peraturan Klasifikasi sebelum dipublikasikan, dengan tujuan memastikan kesesuaian terhadap kebutuhan industri, perkembangan teknologi, serta standar keselamatan nasional dan internasional.

![DSC00710.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_00710_669244b877.JPG)
![DSC00720.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_00720_e90014a204.JPG)

Kegiatan ini dihadiri oleh Direktur Operasi Bisnis Klasifikasi BKI, Arief Budi Permana, Ketua Ikatan Perusahaan Industri Kapal dan Sarana Lepas Pantai Indonesia (IPERINDO), Ir. Anita Puji Utami, ST., MAP., IPM., selaku Ketua Komite Teknik, VP Riset dan Pengembangan Bisnis Klasifikasi & Statutoria BKI, Fredhi Agung Prasetyo, selaku Sekretaris Komite Teknik, serta Direktur Perkapalan dan Kepelautan Kementerian Perhubungan RI, Ir. Samsuddin, M.T., M.Mar.E., bersama anggota KOMTEK BKI lainnya yang terdiri dari para regulator, akademisi, dan praktisi.
Untuk memastikan proses penyusunan peraturan berjalan transparan, objektif, dan akuntabel, BKI melibatkan KOMTEK sebagai wadah representasi para pemangku kepentingan. Komite Teknik berperan memberikan masukan, rekomendasi, serta melakukan tinjauan dan validasi terhadap rancangan Peraturan Klasifikasi maupun hasil penelitian yang menjadi dasar pengembangannya.

Direktur Operasi Bisnis Klasifikasi BKI, Arief Budi Permana, menekankan pentingnya keterlibatan pihak eksternal dalam proses penyusunan Peraturan Teknik guna memastikan penerapan yang konsisten dan dapat dipahami oleh seluruh pemangku kepentingan. “Dari sisi operasional, validasi eksternal penting untuk memastikan Peraturan Teknik BKI, khususnya Rules, dapat diterapkan secara konsisten di lapangan, tidak menimbulkan multi-interpretasi, serta dapat digunakan dan diterima oleh seluruh stakeholder BKI,” ujar Arief.
Pada sidang tahun ini, KOMTEK membahas tinjauan dan validasi terhadap 13 Peraturan Klasifikasi yang akan berlaku mulai Juli 2026. Selain itu, sidang juga mengulas perkembangan regulasi dan informasi teknis terkait perkembangan aturan IMO saat ini, serta hasil penelitian yang menjadi dasar penyusunan peraturan baru maupun amandemen.
Selain itu, sidang ini menjadi forum untuk mengidentifikasi berbagai isu teknis dan penyempurnaan akhir sebelum proses publikasi peraturan dilakukan. Langkah ini penting untuk memastikan peraturan yang diterbitkan tetap relevan dengan perkembangan teknologi, kebutuhan industri, dan ketentuan internasional dan nasional.
Melalui Sidang Komite Teknik, BKI menunjukkan komitmennya untuk menghadirkan Peraturan Klasifikasi yang relevan, terpercaya, dan sesuai standar internasional. Upaya ini menjadi bagian dari dukungan BKI terhadap keselamatan, kualitas, dan kemajuan industri maritim nasional.

title: BKI Holds KOMTEK Meeting to Strengthen Relevance of Classification Regulations
full_text:
# BKI Holds KOMTEK Meeting to Strengthen Relevance of Classification Regulations

BKI held a Technical Committee Meeting to review and validate 13 updated Classification Regulations, ensuring alignment with industry needs, technological developments, and international safety standards ahead of their July 2026 implementation.

Jakarta, April 21, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) held a Technical Committee Meeting (KOMTEK) at its Head Office as part of the process of updating its Classification Regulations ahead of publication. The meeting was convened to ensure the regulations remain aligned with industry needs, technological developments, and national and international safety standards.

![DSC00710.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_00710_669244b877.JPG)
![DSC00696.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_00696_f4e0fa0df1.JPG)

The meeting was attended by BKI Director of Classification Business Operations Arief Budi Permana; Chairperson of the Indonesian Ship and Offshore Facilities Industry Association (IPERINDO) and Technical Committee Chairperson Ir. Anita Puji Utami, S.T., M.A.P., IPM.; BKI VP of Research and Development for Classification & Statutory Business Fredhi Agung Prasetyo; and Director of Shipping and Maritime Affairs at the Ministry of Transportation Ir. Samsuddin, M.T., M.Mar.E., along with other KOMTEK members representing regulators, academics, and industry practitioners.

To ensure the drafting process remains transparent, objective, and accountable, BKI involves KOMTEK as a representative forum for stakeholders. The committee provides input and recommendations, while also reviewing and validating draft regulations and the research findings that support them.

Arief Budi Permana emphasized the importance of involving external stakeholders in the drafting of technical regulations to ensure consistent implementation and a shared understanding across the industry. “From an operational perspective, external validation is essential to ensure that BKI’s technical regulations, particularly the rules, can be applied consistently in the field, avoid multiple interpretations, and be accepted by all stakeholders,” he said.

This year’s KOMTEK session reviewed and validated 13 Classification Regulations scheduled to take effect in July 2026. The meeting also discussed current regulatory developments, technical updates related to IMO requirements, and research findings forming the basis for new regulations and amendments.

In addition, the session served as a forum to identify technical issues and make final refinements before publication. The process is intended to ensure that the regulations remain relevant to technological progress, industry needs, and applicable national and international standards.

Through the Technical Committee Meeting, BKI reaffirmed its commitment to delivering classification regulations that are relevant, reliable, and in line with global standards. The effort reflects BKI’s continued support for the safety, quality, and advancement of Indonesia’s maritime industry.

title: BKI Bersama IDSurvey Kembangkan Keterampilan Warga melalui Desa Binaan Nglarangan
full_text:
# BKI Bersama IDSurvey Kembangkan Keterampilan Warga melalui Desa Binaan Nglarangan

BKI bersama IDSurvey meresmikan Program Desa Binaan Nglarangan di Temanggung melalui pelatihan pengelasan untuk mengembangkan keterampilan dan membuka peluang usaha masyarakat sebagai bagian dari program TJSL hingga 2028.

Temanggung, 23 September 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI bersama IDSurvey Group meresmikan Program Desa Binaan Nglarangan di Kecamatan Tretep, Kabupaten Temanggung, Jawa Tengah. Melalui program Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan (TJSL), BKI berperan dalam pengembangan keterampilan masyarakat melalui pelatihan pengelasan sebagai bagian dari upaya membuka peluang usaha baru bagi warga.

![DSC04113.jpg.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_04113_jpg_6a95d40e6a.jpeg)
![DSC04203.jpg.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_04203_jpg_2f651de1bd.jpeg)

Program Desa Binaan Nglarangan dirancang hingga 2028 dengan fokus pada pengembangan pendidikan, lingkungan, dan usaha masyarakat melalui tiga bidang utama, yaitu IDS Skill Plus, IDS EcoAssure, dan IDS UMKM Growth Hub. Pelaksanaan program diawali dengan pemetaan sosial, survei kebutuhan, serta diskusi bersama Bapperida, pemerintah daerah, pemerintah desa, dan masyarakat untuk menyesuaikan program dengan potensi dan kebutuhan warga.
Dalam pelaksanaannya, BKI bersama IDSurvey memanfaatkan kompetensi yang dimiliki untuk mendukung pengembangan keterampilan pengelasan bagi masyarakat. Pelatihan tersebut diarahkan untuk memberikan pengetahuan dan keterampilan praktis yang dapat dimanfaatkan warga sebagai salah satu alternatif pengembangan usaha dan sumber penghasilan.
Direktur Kelembagaan dan Sumber Daya BKI, R. Agus Doddy Dwisagita, yang hadir dalam peresmian tersebut, menyampaikan bahwa dukungan BKI dalam program ini merupakan bagian dari upaya perusahaan untuk memberikan manfaat yang dapat diterapkan secara langsung oleh masyarakat. “Kami berharap keterampilan yang diperoleh melalui program ini dapat menjadi bekal bagi masyarakat untuk mengembangkan kemampuan secara mandiri dan memanfaatkannya sebagai peluang usaha sesuai dengan potensi yang dimiliki,” ujar Doddy.
Pelatihan yang diberikan menjadi bagian dari tahapan pengembangan kapasitas masyarakat dalam Program Desa Binaan Nglarangan. Setelah pelaksanaan program prioritas pada 2026, pendampingan akan dilanjutkan dengan penguatan kapasitas pada 2027 dan diarahkan menuju kemandirian masyarakat pada 2028. Dalam proses tersebut, keterampilan yang diperoleh diharapkan dapat dikembangkan dan dimanfaatkan warga sesuai dengan kebutuhan serta potensi ekonomi setempat.
Program Desa Binaan Nglarangan juga menjadi bagian dari kolaborasi IDSurvey Group dengan berbagai pihak dalam mengembangkan kapasitas masyarakat berdasarkan kebutuhan di tingkat desa. Sebagai bagian dari IDSurvey Group, BKI turut berkontribusi dalam program ini melalui pemanfaatan kompetensi perusahaan dalam kegiatan TJSL yang berorientasi pada pengembangan keterampilan dan peningkatan kapasitas masyarakat.

title: Energy Efficiency for Ships
full_text:
# Energy Efficiency for Ships

### Energy Efficiency for Ships

#### Carbon Intensity Indicator (CII)

Annual A–E ratings based on IMO DCS data: reporting ≤ 3 months; SoC ≤ 5 months; corrective plan if rating E (1 year) or D (3 consecutive years).

#### For New Ships: EEDI

EEDI is pushing for new, more efficient & low-emission vessels for ≥ 400 GT.

#### For Existing Vessels: EEXI

EEDI-like principles apply to vessels operating above 400 GT, ensuring the fleet meets climate standards.

#### Global Commitment to a Greener Future

In line with SDG 13, the IMO has implemented mandatory measures to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from shipping through MARPOL Annex VI. As a Recognized Organization (RO), BKI helps your fleet be compliant, efficient, and competitive.

Energy Efficiency for Ships

#### Energy Efficiency Design Index (EEDI)

Energy efficiency standards for new ships ≥ 400 GT, operating at the design stage and during sea trials before publication by the IEEC.

#### Energy Efficiency eXisting ship Index (EEXI)

Implementation of efficiency principles on existing vessels ≥ 400 GT. Including solutions such as SHAPOLI/EPL and the re-issue of the IEEC.

#### Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP)

Parts I, II (IMO DCS), and III (CII): planning, fuel consumption data collection, and continuous performance improvement.

- EEDI Technical File Verification (Preliminary & Final)

- EEXI Approval & IEEC Re-issuance

- SEEMP Agreement Parts I, II, and III

- Issuance of Confirmation of Compliance (CoC) for SEEMP

- Annual Fuel & SoC Data Verification for IMO DCS

- Annual CII calculation & verification

- Approval of Corrective Action Plan for D/E rating

Service

#### Preliminary Verification

EEDI verification at design stage before construction.

#### Final Verification

Survey during sea trial to confirm EEDI value & IEEC issuance.

#### Compliance Assessment

Compare Attained vs. Required EEXI; take action if not met.

A

#### Countermeasures

Implementation of SHAPOLI/EPL or other solutions, with guidance & approval of BKI.

B

#### Verification & Certification

Verification on the first IAPP survey ≥ 1 Jan 2023, then re-issue IEEC.

C

#### Technical Steps: EEDI & EEXI

Focus on ship design & equipment to meet minimum efficiency levels.

MARPOL Annex VI

#### Foundation & Monitoring

Part I

Mandatory since 2013 for all ships ≥ 400 GT. Plans to improve ship energy efficiency.

#### Data collection

Part II (IMO DCS)

For vessels ≥ 5,000 GT. Annual fuel consumption collection & reporting methodology.

#### Performance & Improvements

Part III (CII)

Plan to achieve CII (A–E) rating: calculation methodology, 3-year plan, and self-evaluation procedures.

#### Operational Steps: SEEMP, DCS & CII

Management & monitoring of ship operations for continuous performance improvement.

Ship Energy Management

#### End-to-End Compliance Partner

BKI provides complete statutory services to ensure every deadline & requirement is met with confidence.
