title: IDSurvey Group Facilitates Nationwide Travel for 1,400 Participants in 2026 Eid Homecoming Program
full_text:
# IDSurvey Group Facilitates Nationwide Travel for 1,400 Participants in 2026 Eid Homecoming Program

IDSurvey Group is facilitating travel for 1,400 participants to 10 cities under the 2026 SOE Joint Homecoming Program, supporting safe and affordable Eid travel across Indonesia.

Jakarta, March 17, 2026 — IDSurvey, together with its member companies—PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia, PT Sucofindo, and PT Surveyor Indonesia—continues its active participation in the State-Owned Enterprises (SOEs) Joint Homecoming Program, reaffirming its commitment to Social and Environmental Responsibility (TJSL) and delivering tangible benefits to the public.

![DSC00377.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_00377_7f9ee57236.JPG)
![DSC00407.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_00407_a4eb1b2b7f.JPG)

The Joint Homecoming Program is a nationwide initiative led by SOEs in collaboration with government stakeholders to provide safe, comfortable, and affordable travel during the Eid al-Fitr period. In 2026, the program aims to serve more than 100,000 travelers across Indonesia through integrated land and sea transportation.

This year, the program is strengthened by the integration of participant data across SOEs and the Ministry of Transportation using a single National Identification Number (NIK). This system helps prevent duplicate registrations, improves data accuracy, and ensures the program is delivered more effectively and on target.

IDSurvey Group will facilitate travel for 1,400 participants, including members of the public, communities around operational areas, and frontline personnel such as security staff, receptionists, cleaners, and drivers.

To support the program, IDSurvey Group is deploying 22 buses and train services to multiple destinations. Bus routes will cover ten cities—Semarang, Yogyakarta (via southern and northern routes), Wonogiri, Solo/Surakarta, Surabaya, Malang, Lampung, Palembang, and Padang—while train services will operate to Surabaya.

Departures are scheduled to begin on March 16, 2026, for train passengers from Pasar Senen Station in Jakarta, followed by bus departures on March 17, 2026, from the Gelora Bung Karno (GBK) area in Senayan and IDSurvey Group offices.

Representing the IDSurvey CEO’s directive, BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto emphasized the Group’s commitment to delivering social programs that directly address community needs. He noted that the Joint Homecoming Program is designed to support safe, efficient travel while helping ease congestion during the peak holiday period and enabling people to reunite with their families.

Through strong synergy across its entities, IDSurvey Group continues to optimize resource utilization, enhance community welfare, and contribute to inclusive economic growth. As a leading SOE in Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) services, IDSurvey remains committed to advancing impactful social initiatives while supporting sustainable national development.

title: BKI Secures IACS Statement of Compliance, Advancing Global Quality Standards
full_text:
# BKI Secures IACS Statement of Compliance, Advancing Global Quality Standards

PT BKI (Persero) has obtained a Statement of Compliance under the IACS Quality System Certification Scheme following an independent audit by SGS China, confirming its adherence to international standards for classification and statutory services.

Jakarta, December 26, 2025 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) has been awarded a Statement of Compliance (SoC) for its quality management system following the successful completion of an independent audit conducted by SGS China on December 26, 2025. The recognition confirms that BKI meets the international standards established by the International Association of Classification Societies (IACS) for the delivery of classification and statutory services.
The Statement of Compliance serves as formal confirmation that an organization’s operational and quality management systems conform to applicable international requirements. For BKI, the SoC was granted after a comprehensive audit under the IACS Quality System Certification Scheme (IACS QSCS), covering both organizational governance and service execution.
The audit encompassed assessments at BKI’s head office and branch offices, as well as a Vertical Contract Audit (VCA) evaluating end-to-end service delivery on selected projects. This approach ensured consistency, traceability, and reliability across BKI’s operations.
The assessment was carried out by SGS China, an internationally accredited certification body, providing independent assurance that BKI’s quality management system complies with globally recognized standards.
The IACS QSCS scope covers the technical assessment and survey of vessels and mobile offshore installations, ensuring their safety, seaworthiness, and operational fitness throughout both construction and service life. In addition, BKI performs delegated statutory tasks on behalf of flag administrations, supporting governments in ensuring compliance with international maritime safety and environmental regulations. The certification confirms that these processes are implemented in a structured, measurable, and safety-focused manner.
The achievement of the SoC reflects BKI’s continued commitment to strengthening service quality, enhancing internal controls, and responding to growing global expectations for maritime safety and environmental protection.
This international recognition also reinforces BKI’s efforts to enhance its global standing and supports its ongoing pathway toward IACS membership. By aligning its operations with internationally recognized quality standards, BKI affirms its role in advancing the safety, reliability, and competitiveness of Indonesia’s maritime sector.
Through this achievement, BKI is expected to further strengthen stakeholder confidence and continue contributing to the development of a safe, reliable, and globally competitive shipping industry.

title: Coastal State Services
full_text: # Coastal State Services ### Coastal State Services ### Safeguarding National Waters “BKI provides expert technical services to support the responsibilities of a Coastal State, ensuring vessels operating in national waters are safe, compliant, and environmentally sound” Archipelagic focus • EEZ & Territorial Sea • Compliance-first - Ensure the safety of navigation for all ships. - Protect the marine environment from pollution. - Enforce national and international regulations on foreign vessels exercising innocent passage. #### 1. Verification of Compliance for Foreign Vessels Foreign vessels entering a nation's waters must comply with specific local regulations. BKI verifies that these vessels meet the required standards. - Domestic Regulations: Verification against national requirements (cabotage, safety equipment, manning). - Port Entry Requirements: Technical checks for port-specific safety and environmental standards. #### 2. Port State Control (PSC) Support While PSC is a government function, BKI provides crucial background support—ensuring ships are compliant before arrival and responding rapidly to address any deficiencies on BKI-classed vessels. #### 3. Technical Consultancy for Maritime Infrastructure BKI provides technical advisory and verification for aids to navigation and port/terminal development. - Aids to Navigation (AtoN): Verification of buoys, beacons, and other navigational aids. - Port & Terminal Development: Technical studies and QA for maritime facilities. #### 4. Environmental Protection Advisory Expert guidance on implementing international conventions like MARPOL within national waters, including practical strategies for pollution prevention and response. #### The BKI Advantage: Unmatched Archipelagic Expertise Navigating the waters of an archipelago like Indonesia presents unique challenges. BKI’s unparalleled experience in this environment makes us the ideal technical partner. We help ensure that the rights of the Coastal State are upheld while facilitating safe, efficient, and compliant maritime trade for all. Prevention-first classification approach to minimize PSC detentions. ### The Role and Responsibility of a Coastal State In international maritime law, a Coastal State is a nation that has a coastline. This grants specific rights and imposes responsibilities over the Territorial Sea (up to 12 nautical miles) and the Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ). As Indonesia's national classification society, BKI brings deep archipelagic expertise to support these critical national functions.

title: Layanan Negara Pihak dan Bendera
full_text:
# Layanan Negara Pihak dan Bendera

### Layanan Negara Pihak dan Bendera

### Pendekatan Ganda untuk Kepatuhan Global & Nasional

- Setiap kapal komersial beroperasi di bawah jaringan regulasi yang kompleks, mulai dari konvensi internasional luas yang ditetapkan oleh IMO hingga undang-undang nasional spesifik dari Negara Bendera kapal tersebut. Menavigasi hal ini membutuhkan mitra dengan perspektif ganda—yang memahami panggung global dan memiliki pengetahuan mendalam serta otoritatif tentang persyaratan lokal.

- Sebagai Organisasi Terakreditasi (RO) untuk berbagai Negara Bendera di seluruh dunia, BKI memberikan keunggulan unik ini. Kami menawarkan rangkaian layanan hukum yang lengkap untuk memastikan kapal Anda memenuhi standar keselamatan dan perlindungan lingkungan tertinggi, baik yang beroperasi secara internasional maupun di perairan domestik.

Mitra tunggal yang dapat diandalkan untuk semua kebutuhan hukum Anda.

#### Layanan Perundang-undangan Komprehensif Kami

BKI menyediakan layanan menyeluruh dan tanpa hambatan untuk memastikan pemilik kapal dapat memenuhi persyaratan bendera mereka, di mana pun kapal mereka berada.

#### Standar untuk Kapal Non-Konvensional (NCVS)

- Semua kapal dagang dalam perjalanan domestik.

- Kapal dagang < 500 GT dalam pelayaran internasional.

- Kapal dengan penggerak non-mekanis (tongkang, ponton, kapal layar).

- Kapal Motor Layar Kayu Tradisional (KLM) dan Kapal Kayu Lainnya dengan Mesin Penggerak

- Kapal penangkap ikan.

- Perahu rekreasi.

- Kapal dengan desain baru.

- Kapal negara yang digunakan untuk tujuan komersial.

- Semua kapal yang ada dimodifikasi untuk tujuan lain.

#### Peraturan untuk Kapal Konvensi

Memastikan kapal berbendera Indonesia yang tunduk pada konvensi internasional memenuhi semua standar yang ditetapkan oleh Pemerintah Indonesia.

#### Klasifikasi Wajib

- Panjang antara tegak lurus 20 meter atau lebih.

- Tonase Kotor sebesar 100 atau lebih.

- Mesin penggerak utama dengan daya 250 HP atau lebih.

#### Keahlian Tak Tertandingi untuk Bendera Indonesia

Kemampuan global kami dilengkapi dengan pengetahuan mendalam dan otoritatif kami sebagai lembaga klasifikasi nasional untuk Indonesia. Kami adalah pakar terkemuka dalam memverifikasi kepatuhan terhadap semua peraturan nasional Indonesia.

#### Peraturan Perundang-Undangan Nasional yang Mengatur

Peraturan Menteri Perhubungan Nomor KM 65 Tahun 2009 tentang Standar Kapal Non-Konvensi Bendera Indonesia.

Buku NCVS Resmi dan pedoman teknis terkaitnya.

#### Layanan Global untuk Armada Internasional

- Melakukan semua survei yang diperlukan untuk SOLAS, MARPOL, MLC, dan konvensi IMO utama lainnya.

- Meninjau dan menyetujui rencana serta manual kapal.

- Menerbitkan dan mengesahkan semua sertifikat internasional yang diperlukan untuk memastikan operasi kapal Anda di seluruh dunia tanpa hambatan.

title: Keselamatan Bukan Sekadar Prosedur: BKI Awali Bulan K3 Nasional dengan HSE Strategic Briefing 2026
full_text:
# Keselamatan Bukan Sekadar Prosedur: BKI Awali Bulan K3 Nasional dengan HSE Strategic Briefing 2026

BKI membuka Bulan K3 Nasional 2026 melalui HSE Strategic Briefing yang menegaskan keselamatan kerja sebagai budaya dan karakter, bukan sekadar kepatuhan, guna mendukung lingkungan kerja yang aman, sehat, dan layanan maritim yang andal serta berkelanjutan.

Jakarta, 8 Januari 2026 — Dalam rangka memperingati Bulan Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3) Nasional yang berlangsung setiap 12 Januari hingga 12 Februari, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI menyelenggarakan HSE Strategic Briefing 2026 secara daring sebagai pembuka rangkaian kegiatan peringatan tahun ini. Kegiatan yang digelar melalui Zoom Meeting tersebut diikuti seluruh pegawai dan diisi dengan arahan Direktur Utama BKI, R. Benny Susanto, mengenai arah kebijakan keselamatan kerja tahun 2026.
Kegiatan ini menjadi bagian dari upaya BKI memastikan keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja diterapkan secara konsisten, terutama dalam mendukung pelayanan publik di sektor maritim yang aman dan andal. Melalui tema “Safety Culture: Beyond Compliance, It’s Our Character”, BKI menegaskan bahwa keselamatan kerja bukan hanya kewajiban prosedural, tetapi bagian dari nilai dan perilaku sehari-hari.
Pendekatan ini dinilai penting untuk menjaga keberlanjutan layanan dan melindungi sumber daya manusia sebagai aset utama perusahaan, sekaligus mendukung terciptanya lingkungan kerja yang aman, sehat, dan berkelanjutan.
Direktur Utama BKI, R. Benny Susanto, dalam arahannya menekankan bahwa budaya keselamatan harus tercermin dalam tindakan nyata, bukan sekadar slogan.
“Saya ingin menekankan kembali komitmen kita terhadap budaya keselamatan. Budaya bukan sekadar tulisan di dinding, tetapi tercermin dari apa yang kita lakukan setiap hari, termasuk saat tidak ada yang melihat,” ujar Benny.
Ia juga mengingatkan peran pimpinan dalam memastikan kesiapan fisik dan mental seluruh anggota tim, terutama dalam mencegah risiko kerja akibat kelelahan atau kondisi kesehatan yang tidak prima.
“Mari kita perkuat manajemen kesehatan kerja dan pastikan tindak lanjut Medical Check-Up (MCU) dilakukan secara serius. Orang yang tidak sehat secara fisik maupun mental tidak akan pernah bisa bekerja dengan aman,” tambahnya.
Melalui HSE Strategic Briefing 2026, BKI berupaya memastikan bahwa penerapan keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja berjalan seiring dengan peningkatan kualitas layanan kepada masyarakat. Lingkungan kerja yang aman dan sehat diyakini berkontribusi langsung pada keandalan layanan, pencegahan risiko kecelakaan, serta perlindungan terhadap pekerja dan pengguna jasa di sektor maritim.
Kegiatan ini sekaligus menegaskan komitmen BKI untuk terus mendukung praktik kerja yang bertanggung jawab dan berkelanjutan, sejalan dengan kepentingan publik dan pembangunan nasional.

title: BKI Gelar Sosialisasi Regulasi Keselamatan Kapal di Samarinda
full_text:
# BKI Gelar Sosialisasi Regulasi Keselamatan Kapal di Samarinda

BKI menggelar sosialisasi regulasi keselamatan kapal di Samarinda untuk menyelaraskan pemahaman pemangku kepentingan, memperkuat penerapan standar keselamatan armada nasional, dan mendukung pelayaran yang aman serta berkelanjutan.

Samarinda, 8 Juni 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI menggelar sosialisasi bertajuk Sinergi Regulasi dan Keselamatan: Implementasi Bottom Damage Stability & Dasar Ganda pada Kapal Kargo dan Penumpang Armada Nasional. Kegiatan berlangsung di ASTON Samarinda Hotel & Convention Center, Samarinda, Senin (8/6/2026).

![KTD03234.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/KTD_03234_f5ef54b5e7.jpg)
![DSC03417.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_03417_5f51cbfd6b.jpg)

Acara ini menjadi forum strategis yang mempertemukan regulator, pelaku industri, dan pemangku kepentingan maritim. Tujuannya menyamakan persepsi penerapan regulasi keselamatan kapal sekaligus mendorong peningkatan standar keselamatan armada nasional demi transportasi laut yang aman dan berkelanjutan.

Hadir dalam kegiatan tersebut Direktur Operasi Bisnis Klasifikasi BKI Arief Budi Permana. Turut hadir perwakilan Direktorat Jenderal Perhubungan Laut Kemenhub, yakni Direktur Perkapalan dan Kepelautan Ir. Samsuddin, M.T., M.Mar.E., Kasubdit Rancang Bangun, Garis Muat dan Stabilitas Amir Makbul, M.T., M.Mar, dan Kepala Seksi Status Hukum KSOP Kelas I Samarinda Syahriar, S.SIT., M.H. Selain itu, hadir pula Ketua INSA Samarinda H. Agus Sakhlan, S.E. serta Ketua IPERINDO Kalimantan Timur Dr. H. Untung Suropati, S.E., M.M.

Dalam sambutannya, Direktur Operasi Bisnis Klasifikasi BKI Arief Budi Permana menegaskan bahwa keselamatan pelayaran harus menjadi prioritas seluruh pemangku kepentingan. “Keselamatan bukan hanya kewajiban regulator, tetapi tanggung jawab bersama untuk melindungi jiwa manusia, menjaga aset, dan memastikan keberlanjutan industri pelayaran nasional,” ujarnya.

Sementara itu, Direktur Perkapalan dan Kepelautan Samsuddin menyebut forum ini penting untuk menyamakan pemahaman antara regulator, badan klasifikasi, pemilik kapal, dan galangan. Terutama terkait harmonisasi persyaratan keselamatan kapal.

“Saya berharap ada masukan untuk perbaikan peraturan sesuai kebutuhan masyarakat. Dengan begitu, kita bersama mendukung peningkatan keselamatan kapal serta menciptakan iklim usaha pelayaran yang lebih kompetitif dan berkelanjutan,” ujar Samsuddin.

Melalui sosialisasi ini, BKI menegaskan komitmennya memperkuat keselarasan pemahaman antar pemangku kepentingan. Tujuannya agar proses perencanaan, pembangunan, sertifikasi, hingga pengoperasian kapal berjalan lebih efektif. Upaya ini juga diarahkan untuk mendorong penerapan standar keselamatan yang lebih baik pada armada nasional serta meminimalkan risiko kecelakaan pelayaran.

title: BKI Hosts Maritime Safety Forum to Strengthen Regulatory Alignment
full_text:
# BKI Hosts Maritime Safety Forum to Strengthen Regulatory Alignment

BKI convened regulators, shipowners, shipyards, and maritime stakeholders in Samarinda to strengthen alignment on ship safety regulations, particularly the implementation of bottom damage stability and double bottom requirements.

Samarinda, June 8, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) hosted a maritime safety forum titled “Regulatory and Safety Synergy: Implementing Bottom Damage Stability and Double Bottom Requirements for National Cargo and Passenger Vessels” at the ASTON Samarinda Hotel & Convention Center, Samarinda.

![KTD03234.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/KTD_03234_f5ef54b5e7.jpg)
![DSC03417.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_03417_5f51cbfd6b.jpg)

The event brought together regulators, industry leaders, and maritime stakeholders to strengthen alignment on ship safety regulations and support the implementation of higher safety standards across Indonesia’s national fleet. The forum focused on enhancing understanding of bottom damage stability and double bottom requirements, which play a critical role in improving vessel safety and operational resilience.

Among those attending were BKI Director of Classification Business Operations Arief Budi Permana; Director of Shipping and Maritime Affairs at the Ministry of Transportation, Ir. Samsuddin, M.T., M.Mar.E.; Head of the Design, Load Line and Stability Sub-Directorate Amir Makbul, M.T., M.Mar.; Head of the Legal Status Section of Class I KSOP Samarinda Syahriar, S.SIT., M.H.; Chairman of INSA Samarinda H. Agus Sakhlan, S.E.; and Chairman of IPERINDO East Kalimantan Dr. H. Untung Suropati, S.E., M.M.

In his remarks, Arief Budi Permana highlighted the importance of collective responsibility in maintaining maritime safety.

“Safety is not solely the responsibility of regulators. It is a shared commitment to protecting lives, safeguarding assets, and ensuring the long-term sustainability of Indonesia’s shipping industry,” he said.

Samsuddin emphasized the importance of collaboration among regulators, classification societies, shipowners, and shipyards in ensuring a consistent understanding of ship safety requirements.

“We hope this forum generates constructive input for regulatory improvements that reflect industry needs. Through stronger collaboration, we can enhance maritime safety while fostering a more competitive and sustainable shipping sector,” he said.

Through this initiative, BKI reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening stakeholder understanding of ship design, construction, certification, and operational requirements. The programme is expected to support the adoption of higher safety standards across the national fleet, reduce maritime risks, and contribute to safer and more sustainable maritime transportation in Indonesia.

title: Tata Kelola Manajemen Risiko
full_text:
# ESG > Governance > Proses Manajemen Risiko: Tata Kelola Manajemen Risiko

## Tata Kelola Manajemen Risiko

Sebagai bagian dari penyelenggaraan kegiatan usahanya, BKI berkomitmen menempatkan manajemen risiko sebagai elemen yang menyatu dengan proses bisnis sekaligus pengambilan keputusan strategis. BKI memahami bahwa setiap aktivitas operasional mengandung potensi risiko yang dapat berdampak pada pencapaian visi dan misi Perusahaan. Karena itu, penerapan manajemen risiko diposisikan sebagai salah satu pilar penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik (Good Corporate Governance/GCG), yang dilaksanakan secara terencana, sistematis, dan terstruktur untuk menekan potensi kerugian sekaligus memaksimalkan peluang usaha demi tercapainya sasaran yang telah ditetapkan.

Tata kelola manajemen risiko berada di bawah pengawasan tertinggi Direktur Keuangan, Administrasi, dan Manajemen Risiko yang menjamin arah strategis serta efektivitas penerapan manajemen risiko di seluruh lini organisasi. Pada tataran operasional harian, pelaksanaannya dikoordinasikan oleh Divisi Perencanaan Korporat dan Manajemen Risiko selaku koordinator utama, dengan dukungan Risk Officer yang melakukan pemantauan dan pelaporan risiko secara berkala, serta Risk Owner yang memastikan pengendalian risiko diterapkan langsung pada masing-masing proses bisnis.

Gambar **Struktur Tata Kelola Manajemen Risiko Perusahaan**

Pengelolaan manajemen risiko dan kontrol internal di perusahaan menerapkan pendekatan Three Lines Model (Model Tiga Lini) mengacu pada ISO 31000:2018. Model ini mendefinisikan peran, tanggung jawab, serta kewenangan pada setiap lini secara jelas, sekaligus mengatur tata hubungan dan interaksi antar-lini tersebut.

Gambar **Model Tata Kelola Risiko Tiga Lini Perusahaan**

Pelaksanaan Manajemen Risiko di level Perusahaan dan Anak Perusahaan juga menerapkan pendekatan Model Tiga Lini, di mana juga dilakukan berdasarkan mekanisme Tata Kelola Terintegrasi

Gambar **Model Tata Kelola Risiko TIga Lini Induk-Anak Perusahaan**

Mekanisme penerapan manajemen risiko di BKI dijalankan secara terstruktur melalui pembagian peran yang jelas: Dewan Komisaris menjalankan fungsi pengawasan dan kajian, Direksi menetapkan kebijakan serta risk appetite dan risk tolerance, Unit Kerja Manajemen Risiko mengelola profil dan strategi pengendalian risiko, Unit Kerja bertindak sebagai pemilik risiko yang melaksanakan identifikasi hingga pemantauan, dan Satuan Pengawasan Intern (SPI) memberikan penjaminan independen melalui audit berbasis risiko. Keseluruhan mekanisme ini mengacu pada kerangka Enterprise Risk Management dan standar internasional ISO 31000 tentang Manajemen Risiko guna memastikan penerapan yang sistematis dan berkelanjutan.

title: HASIL SURVEI KEPUASAN PELANGGAN
full_text:
# ESG > Social > Kepuasan Pelanggan: HASIL SURVEI KEPUASAN PELANGGAN

## HASIL SURVEI KEPUASAN PELANGGAN

Sebagai bagian dari komitmen untuk menjaga kualitas layanan dan memperkuat hubungan jangka panjang dengan pelanggan, PT BKI (Persero) secara rutin melaksanakan Survei Kepuasan Pelanggan untuk mengukur persepsi, pengalaman, serta tingkat kepuasan pelanggan terhadap layanan yang diberikan. Survei ini menjadi instrumen penting bagi Perusahaan dalam mengevaluasi kinerja layanan, mengidentifikasi area perbaikan, serta memastikan bahwa layanan yang disediakan senantiasa selaras dengan kebutuhan dan ekspektasi pelanggan dari berbagai segmen industri.

Pelaksanaan survei kepuasan pelanggan dilakukan melalui pendekatan yang komprehensif dan objektif. Perusahaan menyelenggarakan survei secara berkala melalui telesurvey yang dilaksanakan oleh pihak ketiga independen, serta survei langsung yang mencakup kantor pusat hingga kantor cabang (baik untuk cabang klasifikasi maupun cabang komersial). Pendekatan ini memungkinkan Perusahaan untuk memperoleh gambaran yang menyeluruh atas kualitas layanan di seluruh wilayah operasional.

Khusus untuk pelaksanaan Survei Kepuasan Pelanggan Tahun 2025, PT BKI (Persero) menerapkan metodologi yang berbeda dibandingkan tahun-tahun sebelumnya. Sejalan dengan Pedoman Survei Kepuasan Pelanggan IDSurvey, pengukuran kepuasan pelanggan dilakukan menggunakan pendekatan Customer Journey, yaitu metode yang mengevaluasi pengalaman pelanggan secara menyeluruh pada setiap tahapan interaksi dengan Perusahaan. Pendekatan ini tidak hanya mengukur tingkat kepuasan terhadap hasil layanan, tetapi juga memetakan pengalaman pelanggan sejak tahap memperoleh informasi dan melakukan kontak layanan, proses penawaran dan order, pelaksanaan pekerjaan, pembayaran dan penagihan, hingga layanan purna pekerjaan. Dengan pendekatan tersebut, Perusahaan dapat mengidentifikasi titik-titik interaksi (touchpoint) yang memberikan pengalaman positif maupun area yang masih memerlukan perbaikan sehingga rekomendasi peningkatan layanan menjadi lebih terarah dan komprehensif. Berikut adalah capaian Indeks Kepuasan Pelanggan PT BKI (Persero) selama empat tahun terakhir:

| **2025*** | **2024** | **2023** | **2022** |
|---|---|---|---|

| **80,17** | **85,95** | **85,93** | **81.34** |

*Survei kepuasan pelanggan berganti metodologi berbasis pendekatan customer journey

Hasil indeks kepuasan pelanggan PT BKI (Persero) Tahun 2025 melampaui target skor yang ditentukan pada skor 80, menandakan bahwa secara umum layanan Perusahaan menjawab kebutuhan dan ekspektasi pelanggan dengan memuaskan PT BKI (Persero) terus berkomitmen untuk memberikan jasa dan layanan yang komprehensif, sigap, dan efektif kepada pelanggan yang kami hormati.

title: CUSTOMER SATISFACTION SURVEY RESULTS
full_text:
# ESG > Social > Customer Satisfaction: CUSTOMER SATISFACTION SURVEY RESULTS

### CUSTOMER SATISFACTION SURVEY RESULTS

As part of its commitment to maintaining service quality and strengthening long-term relationships with customers, PT BKI (Persero) regularly conducts a Customer Satisfaction Survey to measure customer perception, experience, and level of satisfaction with the services provided. This survey serves as an important instrument for the Company in evaluating service performance, identifying areas for improvement, and ensuring that the services provided remain consistently aligned with the needs and expectations of customers across various industry segments.

The implementation of the customer satisfaction survey is carried out through a comprehensive and objective approach. The Company conducts the survey periodically through telesurvey carried out by an independent third party, as well as direct surveys covering the head office through to branch offices (both classification branches and commercial branches). This approach enables the Company to obtain a comprehensive picture of service quality across all operational regions.

Specifically for the implementation of the 2025 Customer Satisfaction Survey, PT BKI (Persero) applied a different methodology compared to previous years. In line with the IDSurvey Customer Satisfaction Survey Guidelines, the measurement of customer satisfaction was carried out using a Customer Journey approach, namely a method that evaluates the customer experience comprehensively at every stage of interaction with the Company. This approach not only measures the level of satisfaction with the service outcome, but also maps the customer experience starting from the stage of obtaining information and making service contact, the offer and order process, the execution of work, payment and billing, through to after-work service. Through this approach, the Company is able to identify touchpoints that provide a positive experience as well as areas that still require improvement, so that service improvement recommendations become more targeted and comprehensive. The following is the achievement of PT BKI (Persero)'s Customer Satisfaction Index over the past four years:

| 2025 | 2024 | 2023 | 2022 |
|---|---|---|---|

| 80,17 | 85,95 | 85,93 | 81,34 |

The customer satisfaction index of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) for 2025 exceeded the established target score of 80, indicating that the Company’s services in general have satisfactorily met customer needs and expectations. customer needs and expectations. PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) remains committed to delivering comprehensive, responsive, and effective services to its valued customers.

title: Menguatkan Kepemimpinan di Era Transisi Hijau: BKI & Neyen Selenggarakan Executive Workshop
full_text:
# Menguatkan Kepemimpinan di Era Transisi Hijau: BKI & Neyen Selenggarakan Executive Workshop

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)/BKI bersama Neyen Consulting melalui inisiatif inFUSE menyelenggarakan Executive Workshop bertajuk “Navigating Sustainability, Risk, and Opportunity in a Changing World” pada 25 November 2025 di Jakarta.

Jakarta, 25 November 2025 – Di tengah perubahan global yang semakin cepat, kebutuhan akan pemimpin yang mampu mengelola transisi keberlanjutan menjadi semakin penting. Menjawab tantangan tersebut, Neyen Consulting bersama PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI, melalui inisiatif inFUSE, menyelenggarakan Executive Workshop bertajuk “Navigating Sustainability, Risk, and Opportunity in a Changing World” di Shangri-La Hotel, Jakarta.
Kegiatan ini dibuka oleh Direktur Keuangan, Manajemen Risiko & Dukungan Bisnis BKI, R. Agus Doddy Dwisagita, serta menghadirkan sambutan dari Managing Partner Neyen Consulting, Miguel Rescalvo. Hadir pula Prof. Ricardo G. Barcelona, Fellow Energy Institute (London) & Asian Institute of Management, sebagai narasumber ahli, dan Djoko Siswanto, Kepala SKK Migas, sebagai tamu undangan khusus.
Workshop ini dirancang untuk eksekutif C-level dan pengambil keputusan senior yang memegang peran strategis dalam organisasi. Melalui kegiatan ini, para peserta mendapatkan gambaran menyeluruh tentang bagaimana risiko global, peluang bisnis, dan tuntutan keberlanjutan mempengaruhi arah perkembangan sektor industri di Indonesia.
Pengetahuan yang diperoleh tidak hanya bermanfaat bagi perusahaan, tetapi juga berdampak pada sektor publik melalui peningkatan tata kelola, efisiensi sumber daya, dan praktik bisnis yang lebih bertanggung jawab terhadap lingkungan.
Selain sesi pemaparan, peserta mengikuti diskusi interaktif dan pembahasan studi kasus yang mencerminkan tantangan nyata dunia bisnis saat ini. Pendekatan ini membantu para pemimpin organisasi memahami konteks lapangan dan menyusun respons strategis yang relevan bagi kebutuhan industri dan masyarakat luas.
Sebagai bagian dari pengayaan pengetahuan, tersedia sesi tatap muka opsional bersama Prof. Ricardo G. Barcelona. Sesi ini memberikan pandangan akademis sekaligus praktis untuk memperdalam pemahaman peserta mengenai pengelolaan keberlanjutan di tengah dinamika perubahan global.
Pelaksanaan workshop ini menjadi langkah nyata dalam meningkatkan kapasitas kepemimpinan di Indonesia, khususnya dalam menghadapi isu-isu keberlanjutan, ketidakpastian global, dan tuntutan perubahan industri. Dengan penguatan kompetensi pemimpin perusahaan, diharapkan pengambilan keputusan strategis dapat lebih adaptif dan berorientasi pada kepentingan publik, lingkungan, serta keberlanjutan jangka panjang.

# ESG > Environment > Internal Carbon Pricing: KOMITMEN NET ZERO EMISSION

## KOMITMEN NET ZERO EMISSION

## PT BIRO KLASIFIKASI INDONESIA (PERSERO)

Sebagai bagian dari IDSurvey Group yang bergerak di bidang jasa klasifikasi, inspeksi, pengujian, dan sertifikasi (Testing, Inspection, Certification, Consulting, and Classification/TICCC), PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) yang selanjutnya disebut BKI memandang isu perubahan iklim bukan hanya sebagai tantangan global, melainkan juga sebagai bagian integral dari tanggung jawab bisnis yang harus dikelola secara sistematis dan terukur. Komitmen ini semakin relevan mengingat peran BKI dalam mendukung industri nasional melalui layanan klasifikasi dan sertifikasi yang turut berkontribusi terhadap transisi menuju perekonomian rendah karbon.

Pemerintah Indonesia, melalui Peraturan Presiden No. 110 Tahun 2025, telah menegaskan arah kebijakan nasional dalam menurunkan emisi gas rumah kaca, sebagaimana dijabarkan lebih lanjut dalam Enhanced Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC). Selaras dengan arah kebijakan tersebut serta target nasional Net Zero Emission (NZE) pada tahun 2060 atau lebih awal, BKI menegaskan komitmennya untuk berkontribusi aktif dalam pencapaian target dimak sud melalui langkah-langkah berikut:

1. Melaksanakan inventarisasi emisi Gas Rumah Kaca (GRK) secara aktif dan berkesinambungan pada Cakupan (Scope) 1, Cakupan (Scope) 2, dan Cakupan (Scope) 3, sebagai landasan pengukuran jejak karbon Perseroan yang akurat dan dapat dipertanggungjawabkan.
2. Menyusun roadmap Net Zero Emission yang akan dikembangkan secara serentak bersama seluruh entitas anggota IDSurvey Group pada tahun 2027, guna menetapkan tahun dasar (base year), target antara (interim target), serta strategi dekarbonisasi lintas cakupan emisi secara terintegrasi.
3. Melaksanakan berbagai inisiatif dan program reduksi emisi secara aktif di seluruh lini operasional Perseroan, sebagai wujud nyata kontribusi terhadap pencapaian target Net Zero Emission.

Sebagai bagian dari penguatan tata kelola iklim, BKI juga berkomitmen untuk mengkaji dan mengembangkan mekanisme harga karbon internal (internal carbon price) sebagai salah satu instrumen perencanaan strategis Perseroan. Mekanisme ini akan digunakan untuk mendukung analisis biaya-manfaat (cost-benefit analysis), mendorong efisiensi energi, mengarahkan pertimbangan risiko dan peluang terkait iklim dalam pengambilan keputusan bisnis, serta menjadi acuan dalam perencanaan investasi rendah karbon Perseroan ke depan. Penerapan harga karbon internal ini akan dikembangkan secara bertahap sejalan dengan penyusunan roadmap Net Zero Emission IDSurvey Group pada tahun 2027.

title: Risk Governance
full_text:
# ESG > Governance > Risk Management Process: Risk Governance

## Risk Governance

As part of conducting its business activities, BKI is committed to positioning risk management as an element integral to both its business processes and its strategic decision-making. BKI understands that every operational activity carries potential risks that may affect the achievement of the Company's vision and mission. For this reason, the implementation of risk management is established as one of the pillars of Good Corporate Governance (GCG), carried out in a planned, systematic, and structured manner to minimize potential losses while maximizing business opportunities in order to attain the established objectives.

Risk management governance rests under the highest oversight of the Director of Finance, Administration, and Risk Management, who ensures the strategic direction and effectiveness of risk management implementation across the entire organization. At the day-to-day operational level, its execution is coordinated by the Corporate Planning and Risk Management Division as the main coordinator, supported by Risk Officers who monitor and report risks periodically, and Risk Owners who ensure that risk controls are applied directly within their respective business processes.

**Company Risk Management Governance Structure**

Risk management and internal control in the company are managed in accordance with ISO 31000:2018-based Three Lines Model. This model clearly defines the roles, responsibilities, and authorities at each line, while establishing the relationship and interaction between them.

**Three Lines Model for Corporate RIsk Governance**

Risk Management implementation at both the Holding Company and Subsidiary levels adopts the Three Lines Model approach, which is executed through an Integrated Governance mechanism.

**Parent-Subsidiary Three Lines Risk Governance Model**

BKI's risk management implementation mechanism is carried out in a structured manner through a clear division of roles: the Board of Commissioners performs the oversight and review function, the Board of Directors establishes policies as well as the risk appetite and risk tolerance, the Risk Management Unit manages the risk profile and control strategy, the Work Units act as risk owners carrying out everything from identification to monitoring, and the Internal Audit Unit (SPI) provides independent assurance through risk-based audits. This entire mechanism refers to the Enterprise Risk Management framework and the international standard ISO 31000 on Risk Management to ensure a systematic and sustainable application.

# BKI and Brawijaya University Strengthen Strategic Cooperation Through MoU on Education, Research, and Community Service

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) has formalized a strategic partnership with Universitas Brawijaya (UB) through the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) covering education, research, community service, and human resource development.

Surabaya, August 28, 2025 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) has formalized a strategic partnership with Universitas Brawijaya (UB) through the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) covering education, research, community service, and human resource development. The signing ceremony took place at the UB Rectorate and was attended by senior leaders from both institutions, including BKI Director of Finance, Risk Management, and Business Support R. Agus Doddy Dwi Sagita and UB Rector Prof. Widodo, S.Si., M.Si., Ph.D.Med.Sc.

Also present were Acting Vice President Corporate Secretary of BKI Muhammad Sodik, Head of BKI Surabaya Main Classification Branch Bambang Riyanto, Head of BKI Surabaya Commercial Branch Sudibyo, UB Vice Rector for Planning, Cooperation, and Internationalization Prof. Andi Kurniawan, S.Pi., M.Eng., D.Sc., and UB Vice Rector for Research and Innovation Prof. Dr. Unti Ludigdo, SE., M.Si., Ak.

Speaking at the event, Muhammad Sodik highlighted the importance of the collaboration, noting that the maritime and transportation industry continues to face complex challenges requiring innovative, research-based solutions. “BKI frequently receives requests from stakeholders to address real-world problems. Through this partnership, we can combine industry needs with UB’s academic and research expertise to deliver meaningful solutions,” he said.

UB Rector Prof. Widodo welcomed the collaboration, emphasizing that it aligns with the university’s vision to expand partnerships with industry. “This MoU strengthens UB’s role in contributing to national development by integrating education, research, and innovation with industry practices,” he stated.

The MoU will serve as the foundation for more specific technical cooperation, including initiatives on land transportation standardization (ODOL), fishing vessel safety standards, and maritime baseline mapping to enhance industrial safety and quality.

Through this synergy between academia and industry, BKI and UB are committed to advancing Indonesia’s maritime, transportation, and fisheries sectors by providing practical, research-driven solutions that address both national and global challenges.

title: BKI Launches National Occupational Safety and Health Month with 2026 HSE Strategic Briefing
full_text:
# BKI Launches National Occupational Safety and Health Month with 2026 HSE Strategic Briefing

PT BKI (Persero) launched its HSE Strategic Briefing 2026 to mark the start of National OSH Month, reaffirming its commitment to embedding safety culture beyond regulatory compliance.

Jakarta, January 8, 2026 — In commemoration of National Occupational Safety and Health (OSH/K3) Month, observed from January 12 to February 12, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) launched its HSE Strategic Briefing 2026 through an online session held via Zoom. The briefing marked the opening of BKI’s series of OSH Month activities and was attended by employees across the organization.
The session featured a strategic address from BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto, who outlined the company’s occupational safety and health policy direction for 2026 and reaffirmed management’s commitment to strengthening a sustainable safety culture.
Carrying the theme “Safety Culture: Beyond Compliance, It’s Our Character,” the briefing emphasized that occupational safety and health must go beyond regulatory requirements and be embedded in everyday attitudes and behaviors. This approach is considered essential to ensuring service continuity, protecting human capital as the company’s most valuable asset, and fostering a safe, healthy, and resilient work environment.
In his remarks, Benny Susanto stressed that safety culture must be demonstrated through consistent actions, not merely stated in policies or slogans.
“Culture is not just words on the wall—it is reflected in what we do every day, even when no one is watching,” he said.
He also highlighted the critical role of leadership in safeguarding employees’ physical and mental well-being, particularly in mitigating risks associated with fatigue and health issues. Benny underscored the importance of strengthening occupational health management and ensuring serious follow-up on Medical Check-Up (MCU) results, noting that employees who are not physically or mentally fit cannot work safely.
Through the HSE Strategic Briefing 2026, BKI seeks to ensure that the implementation of occupational safety and health remains aligned with continuous service quality improvement. A safe and healthy workplace is viewed as a key enabler of reliable public services, accident prevention, and the protection of both workers and service users within the maritime sector.
This initiative further reinforces BKI’s ongoing commitment to responsible, sustainable work practices that support public safety and contribute to national development.

title: BKI and Neyen Host Executive Workshop on Leadership for the Sustainability Transition
full_text:
# BKI and Neyen Host Executive Workshop on Leadership for the Sustainability Transition

BKI and Neyen Consulting held an Executive Workshop to strengthen leadership capacity in navigating sustainability, risk, and emerging business opportunities amid global change.

Jakarta, November 25, 2025 – As global sustainability demands continue to reshape business landscapes, the need for leaders equipped to navigate the green transition is more critical than ever. Responding to this challenge, Neyen Consulting and PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI), through the inFUSE initiative, hosted an Executive Workshop titled “Navigating Sustainability, Risk, and Opportunity in a Changing World” at the Shangri-La Hotel, Jakarta.

![MRC05671.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/MRC_05671_5cb070e201.jpg)
![MRC05536.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/MRC_05536_8d7135c0bc.jpg)
![DSC01273.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_01273_e61c32eddc.jpg)

The event was opened by R. Agus Doddy Dwisagita, BKI’s Director of Finance, Risk Management & Business Support, and featured remarks from Miguel Rescalvo, Managing Partner of Neyen Consulting. The workshop also welcomed Prof. Ricardo G. Barcelona, Fellow of the Energy Institute (London) and the Asian Institute of Management, as the keynote expert, and Djoko Siswanto, Head of SKK Migas, as a special guest.

Designed for C-level executives and senior strategic leaders, the workshop provided an in-depth understanding of how global risks, emerging opportunities, and sustainability imperatives shape Indonesia’s industrial direction. The insights shared are expected to strengthen decision-making processes across both the private and public sectors, supporting improved governance, resource efficiency, and environmentally responsible business practices.

Participants also engaged in interactive discussions and real-world case studies, enabling them to contextualize challenges and develop strategic responses tailored to evolving industry needs. As part of the knowledge-enhancement series, an optional in-person session with Prof. Barcelona was offered to provide deeper academic and practical perspectives on sustainability management.

This workshop marks a concrete step in advancing Indonesia’s leadership capacity in the face of global uncertainty, industry transformation, and growing sustainability expectations. By equipping leaders with strategic and forward-looking competencies, the initiative aims to support more adaptive, responsible, and long-term decision-making across the national industrial landscape.

title: BKI Berpartisipasi dalam Pengabdian Masyarakat FIA UI di Batam
full_text:
# BKI Berpartisipasi dalam Pengabdian Masyarakat FIA UI di Batam

BKI berpartisipasi dalam pengabdian masyarakat FIA UI dan PT Pegaunihan Technology Indonesia di Batam.

Batam, 19 September 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI berpartisipasi dalam kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat yang diselenggarakan oleh tim dosen Fakultas Ilmu Administrasi Universitas Indonesia (FIA UI) bekerja sama dengan PT Pegaunihan Technology Indonesia di Batam, Kepulauan Riau. Mengangkat tema “Well-Being and Performance at Work: Enhancing Employee Well-Being to Support Individual and Corporate Performance,” kegiatan ini diikuti oleh sekitar 50 karyawan PT Pegaunihan Technology Indonesia dari berbagai divisi untuk memperkuat pemahaman mengenai kesejahteraan dan kinerja di lingkungan kerja.
Dalam kegiatan tersebut, VP Human Capital BKI, Abdur Rahman, menyampaikan materi bertajuk “Financial Wellbeing, Healthy Finance, Better Focus at Work”. Materi ini membahas keterkaitan antara pengelolaan keuangan pribadi, kesejahteraan karyawan, dan kemampuan menjaga fokus dalam menjalankan pekerjaan.
Selain pemaparan materi, kegiatan dilengkapi dengan diskusi dan tanya jawab, penyusunan rencana tindakan pribadi (personal action plan), serta evaluasi. Rangkaian aktivitas tersebut memberikan kesempatan kepada peserta untuk menghubungkan pemahaman mengenai keterlibatan karyawan (employee engagement), keseimbangan kehidupan dan pekerjaan (work-life balance), serta kesejahteraan finansial (financial well-being) dengan langkah-langkah yang dapat diterapkan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari dan lingkungan kerja.
Abdur Rahman menyampaikan bahwa pemahaman mengenai kondisi keuangan pribadi perlu diikuti dengan kebiasaan yang dapat membantu karyawan mengelola prioritas dan menjaga keseimbangan dalam menjalankan aktivitas sehari-hari. “Kesejahteraan finansial bukan hanya berkaitan dengan kemampuan mengelola pendapatan dan pengeluaran, tetapi juga bagaimana seseorang membangun kebiasaan keuangan yang sehat agar dapat menjalankan aktivitas dan tanggung jawabnya dengan lebih tenang dan terarah,” ujar Rahman.
Kegiatan ini menjadi ruang kolaborasi antara perguruan tinggi dan dunia industri untuk menghubungkan pengetahuan akademik dengan kebutuhan praktis di lingkungan kerja. Melalui keterlibatan BKI bersama FIA UI dan PT Pegaunihan Technology Indonesia, kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini turut mendukung pertukaran pengetahuan mengenai pengembangan sumber daya manusia yang memperhatikan aspek kesejahteraan, produktivitas, dan keberlanjutan.

title: Enhancing Collaboration and Effectiveness, BKI Surabaya Branch Inaugurates New Office
full_text:
# Enhancing Collaboration and Effectiveness, BKI Surabaya Branch Inaugurates New Office

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI), as the lead of the State-Owned Enterprises (SOEs) Survey Services Holding (IDSurvey) which also includes PT Sucofindo and PT Surveyor Indonesia, officially inaugurated its new Surabaya Branch Office

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI), as the lead of the State-Owned Enterprises (SOEs) Survey Services Holding (IDSurvey) which also includes PT Sucofindo and PT Surveyor Indonesia, officially inaugurated its new Surabaya Branch Office for Classification & Commercial Services on January 16, 2025, located on the 3rd floor of Graha Sucofindo. The inauguration was led by Mr. Arisudono Soerono, President Director of IDSurvey/BKI.

The ceremony was attended by Mr. Rozainbahri Noor, Director of Human Capital Development of IDSurvey; Mr. Jobi Triananda Hasjim, President Director of PT Sucofindo; Mr. David Sidjabat, Director of Human Resources of PT Sucofindo; Mr. Bambang Riyanto, Head of BKI Surabaya Main Classification Branch; Mr. Sudibyo, Head of BKI Surabaya Commercial Branch; Mr. Muhamad Surahman, Head of PT Sucofindo Surabaya Branch; and Mr. Dwi Yulinar Firdaus, Head of PT Surveyor Indonesia Surabaya Branch.
The new branch office is expected to improve operational efficiency, productivity, and contribute to the national economy. The inauguration was marked by a traditional tumpeng ceremony as an expression of gratitude, followed by a joint prayer for future success. As part of its social commitment, BKI also provided donations to orphans, reaffirming its dedication to community welfare. BKI hopes that the new office will not only strengthen operations but also bring tangible benefits to the local community, fostering synergy between business and society.

In his remarks, Mr. Arisudono Soerono, President Director of BKI, highlighted the importance of creating a representative and welcoming office environment.

“This office must be a bright, comfortable place that facilitates customer service, not the opposite,” he stated, underlining the company’s commitment to ensuring comfort for clients and visitors.
Beyond enhancing customer service, the new office was also designed to promote employee well-being. Mr. Arisudono added,

“This office must be enjoyable for employees—comfortable and attentive to Employee Well-being—aligned with the policy of the Minister of SOEs issued in early 2024, to create a productive, healthy, safe, comfortable, and happy working environment.”

title: BKI Raih Penghargaan Transportasi Indonesia Award 2026
full_text:
# BKI Raih Penghargaan Transportasi Indonesia Award 2026

BKI meraih penghargaan “Leading Classification and Certification Institution For Maritime Safety” pada Transportasi Indonesia Award 2026 atas kontribusinya dalam memperkuat keselamatan transportasi maritim melalui layanan klasifikasi dan sertifikasi.

Jakarta, 30 Juli 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI menerima penghargaan pada ajang Transportasi Indonesia Award 2026 yang diselenggarakan di Auditorium Binakarna, Jakarta. Penghargaan tersebut diberikan sebagai bentuk apresiasi atas kontribusi BKI dalam memperkuat keselamatan transportasi maritim melalui layanan klasifikasi, sertifikasi, dan penjaminan kepatuhan terhadap standar industri.

Penghargaan diterima langsung oleh Direktur Operasi Bisnis Klasifikasi BKI, Arief Budi Permana. Pada kesempatan tersebut, BKI dianugerahi penghargaan "Leading Classification and Certification Institution For Maritime Safety" sebagai bentuk pengakuan atas dedikasi dan kontribusinya dalam mendukung kemajuan sektor transportasi Indonesia.

Transportasi Indonesia Award merupakan ajang penghargaan yang memberikan apresiasi kepada perusahaan, institusi, dan pemimpin di sektor transportasi atas inovasi, kualitas layanan, serta kontribusinya dalam mendukung pengembangan sistem transportasi nasional yang aman, berkelanjutan, dan berdaya saing. Melalui penghargaan ini, berbagai inisiatif yang mendukung peningkatan kualitas dan keselamatan transportasi nasional memperoleh pengakuan atas kontribusinya terhadap kemajuan sektor transportasi di Indonesia.

Menanggapi penghargaan tersebut, Direktur Operasi Bisnis Klasifikasi BKI, Arief Budi Permana, menyampaikan bahwa pengakuan yang diterima menjadi dorongan bagi BKI untuk terus menjaga kualitas pelaksanaan tugasnya sekaligus memberikan kontribusi yang relevan bagi perkembangan sektor maritim. “Penghargaan ini menjadi apresiasi sekaligus motivasi bagi BKI untuk terus meningkatkan kualitas layanan serta menjadi tanggung jawab bagi kami untuk terus memastikan setiap proses dilaksanakan secara profesional dan sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku,” ujar Arief.

Penghargaan yang diterima BKI pada ajang ini mencerminkan apresiasi terhadap BKI dalam memperkuat keselamatan pelayaran melalui layanan yang mendukung kepatuhan terhadap ketentuan dan standar yang berlaku di industri maritim. Dengan capaian ini, BKI menegaskan posisinya sebagai salah satu institusi yang berperan dalam mendukung kemajuan transportasi nasional, khususnya di sektor kelautan dan pelayaran.

title: BKI Supports Directorate General of Sea Transportation in 2026 Passenger Ship Seaworthiness Inspections
full_text:
# BKI Supports Directorate General of Sea Transportation in 2026 Passenger Ship Seaworthiness Inspections

PT BKI (Persero), in coordination with the Directorate General of Sea Transportation, conducted comprehensive seaworthiness inspections of passenger vessels in Makassar ahead of the 2026 Eid al-Fitr homecoming season. The initiative aims to ensure vessels meet safety, technical, and service standards to support secure and reliable maritime travel during the peak holiday period.

Makassar, February 18, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI), in collaboration with the Directorate General of Sea Transportation under the Ministry of Transportation of the Republic of Indonesia, conducted seaworthiness inspections for passenger vessels ahead of the 2026 Eid al-Fitr holiday season. The inspections took place at the Makassar Harbormaster and Port Authority Office (KSOP) to ensure vessels operating during the annual homecoming period meet strict safety and operational standards.

![IMG_0677.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/IMG_0677_b5462c81d4.jpg)
![IMG_0683.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/IMG_0683_b0aeafc27d.jpg)

The seaworthiness inspections, commonly referred to as spot checks, involved comprehensive on-site assessments of vessel conditions, including hull integrity, machinery performance, safety equipment, and supporting facilities. The objective is to confirm that each vessel is fully prepared to operate safely during the anticipated surge in passenger traffic.

BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto attended the inspection activities, underscoring the company’s role as a maritime classification and survey institution committed to upholding regulatory compliance and operational safety.

The inspections extended beyond document verification to include direct technical checks of onboard safety systems and overall vessel readiness. This proactive approach aims to prevent operational lapses and mitigate risks during one of Indonesia’s busiest travel periods.

In addition to technical evaluations, inspections also covered passenger facilities and vessel cleanliness to ensure comfort throughout the journey. These measures are intended to provide reassurance to the public traveling by sea during the Eid holiday.

Through its involvement, BKI reaffirms its commitment to strengthening maritime safety oversight by providing technical expertise and objective inspections, helping to maintain high safety standards across Indonesia’s maritime transportation sector.

# BKI Hadiri Asia Pacific Maritime 2026, Perkuat Kolaborasi Industri Maritim Global

BKI menghadiri pameran dan konferensi maritim Asia Pacific Maritime (APM) 2026 yang berlangsung di Singapura.

Singapura, 25 Maret 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI menghadiri pameran dan konferensi maritim Asia Pacific Maritime (APM) 2026 yang berlangsung di Singapura. Kehadiran BKI dalam ajang ini bertujuan memperluas jejaring kerja sama dengan pelaku industri maritim regional dan global, sekaligus memperkenalkan peran dan kapabilitas perusahaan di tingkat internasional.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-25 at 15.22.01 (1).jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_03_25_at_15_22_01_1_18673806bf.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-25 at 15.22.02 (1).jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_03_25_at_15_22_02_1_8ed9947eff.jpeg)

Dalam kegiatan tersebut, Direktur Utama BKI, R. Benny Susanto, hadir bersama VP Operasi Bisnis Klasifikasi, Munir M, serta delegasi BKI. Partisipasi ini menjadi momentum bagi BKI untuk berinteraksi langsung dengan berbagai pemangku kepentingan industri, termasuk pelaku usaha perkapalan, sektor lepas pantai, serta pengembang teknologi kelautan.
Asia Pacific Maritime merupakan salah satu forum maritim terkemuka di kawasan Asia yang mempertemukan pelaku industri dari berbagai negara. Pameran dan konferensi ini membahas perkembangan industri pembangunan kapal, workboat, sektor lepas pantai, serta teknologi maritim, termasuk pengembangan sistem kelautan berbasis listrik dan hibrida.
Dalam rangkaian kegiatan, delegasi BKI juga mengunjungi sejumlah booth peserta pameran, di antaranya Indonesian National Shipowner’s Association (INSA) dan Ikatan Perusahaan Industri Kapal dan Sarana Lepas Pantai Indonesia (IPERINDO) yang mewakili Indonesia dalam forum tersebut. Kunjungan ini menjadi bagian dari upaya memperkuat sinergi antar pelaku industri nasional di tingkat internasional.
Dalam kesempatan tersebut, BKI juga melakukan kunjungan ke kantor Weichai Group. Weichai Group merupakan perusahaan global yang bergerak di bidang produksi mesin, termasuk mesin kelautan. Kunjungan ini menjadi bagian dari upaya membuka peluang pertukaran informasi serta penjajakan kerja sama yang mendukung pengembangan industri maritim.
Melalui keikutsertaan dalam Asia Pacific Maritime 2026, BKI menunjukkan komitmennya untuk terus terlibat dalam perkembangan industri maritim global serta memperluas peran Indonesia dalam ekosistem maritim internasional.

title: Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
BKI Launches SMK3 Audit for Three ASDP Branches
full_text:
# BKI Launches SMK3 Audit for Three ASDP Branches

BKI officially launched the SMK3 certification audit for ASDP’s Kupang, Ternate, and Ambon branches, reinforcing its role as an accredited occupational safety and health audit institution.

Jakarta, May 29, 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) officially commenced the Occupational Safety and Health Management System (SMK3) certification audit for three branches of PT ASDP Indonesia Ferry (Persero) through a Kick-Off Meeting held at Bhineka Hall, BKI Head Office, Jakarta.

![DSC03219.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_03219_afb990eb17.jpg)
![DSC03170.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_03170_ea96f96803.jpg)

The audit covers ASDP’s Kupang, Ternate, and Ambon branches and marks the beginning of a certification process carried out under BKI’s authority as an accredited SMK3 Audit Institution, as designated by the Decree of the Minister of Manpower of the Republic of Indonesia.

The event was attended by BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto and members of the company’s management team, alongside ASDP Deputy President Director Yossianis Marciano and ASDP management representatives.

The initiative aligns with the 2026 National Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) Month theme, “Building a Professional, Reliable, and Collaborative National OSH Management Ecosystem.” Through the audit process, ASDP reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening occupational safety and health practices across its operations, while BKI continues to support the implementation of national workplace safety standards through independent audit and certification services.

In his remarks, Benny emphasized that SMK3 implementation extends beyond regulatory compliance and serves as a foundation for building a safe, healthy, and productive workplace culture.

"ASDP’s commitment to implementing SMK3 across its Kupang, Ternate, and Ambon branches demonstrates not only compliance with regulations, but also a strong commitment to fostering a safe, healthy, and productive working environment," he said.

The kick-off meeting reflects the ongoing collaboration between BKI and ASDP in promoting robust occupational safety and health practices, particularly within regional operational units. Through the SMK3 certification process, both organizations aim to strengthen workplace safety performance and support the development of sustainable operational standards across the maritime transportation sector.

title: BKI & PELNI Berkolaborasi: Wujudkan Transportasi Laut Berkualitas
full_text:
# BKI & PELNI Berkolaborasi: Wujudkan Transportasi Laut Berkualitas

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)/BKI menandatangani nota kesepahaman dengan PT Pelayaran Nasional Indonesia (Persero)/PELNI pada 6 Februari 2025 di Jakarta.

JAKARTA – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI, sebagai lead holding jasa survei BUMN, IDSurvey, yang terdiri dari PT SUCOFINDO dan PT Surveyor Indonesia kembali memperkuat sinergi di sektor maritim. Pada 6 Februari 2025, BKI menandatangani nota kesepahaman (MoU) dengan PT Pelayaran Nasional Indonesia (Persero) atau PELNI di Kantor Pusat BKI, Jakarta. Kolaborasi ini bertujuan meningkatkan keselamatan dan efisiensi transportasi laut melalui berbagai inisiatif strategis.

Penandatanganan nota kesepahaman ini dihadiri oleh Andry Tanudjaja selaku Direktur Hubungan Kelembagaan PT BKI (Persero), Robert MP Sinaga selaku Direktur Armada dan Teknik PT PELNI (Persero), Deputi Direktur Manajemen Bisnis Klasifikasi PT BKI (Persero), Arief Budi Permana, Deputi Direktur Manajemen Bisnis Komersil PT BKI (Persero), Erwin Ernanto Hoesni, VP Divisi Pemasaran Korporat IDSurvey, Winda Ary Susanti, VP Owner Surveyor PT PELNI (Persero), Darman, VP Nautika PT PELNI (Persero), Tomi Santoso, VP Pengelolaan Bahan Bakar & Pelumas PT PELNI (Persero), Otto Van Muller.

Kerja sama ini merupakan langkah strategis dalam memperkuat sinergi antar BUMN di sektor maritim yang mencakup berbagai aspek penting dalam industri maritim, mulai dari pelatihan dan pengembangan sumber daya manusia, pemanfaatan teknologi survei dan inspeksi, hingga klasifikasi kapal dan aspek teknis lainnya. Sinergi ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan standar keselamatan kapal, mendukung pemeliharaan armada, serta mendorong inovasi dalam operasional transportasi laut.

“Tujuan dari MoU ini adalah memperkuat kerja sama antar BUMN di sektor maritim, khususnya dalam aspek keselamatan kapal. Kami ingin mendukung PELNI dalam pembangunan kapal baru, dan perawatan armada serta memastikan standar kesehatan dan keselamatan kapal tetap terjaga,” ujar Andry Tanudjaja.

Senada dengan hal tersebut, Direktur Armada dan Teknik PT PELNI (Persero), Robert MP Sinaga, menegaskan pentingnya peran BKI dalam klasifikasi kapal dan berharap kerjasama ini terus berkembang. "Kami berharap sinergi ini semakin erat. Seluruh kapal PELNI telah diklasifikasi oleh BKI, dan kami sangat mengandalkan dukungan serta masukan mereka, terutama dalam jasa survei dan konsultasi,” ungkapnya.

title: NET ZERO EMISSION COMMITMENT
full_text:
# ESG > Environment > Decarbonization Strategy: NET ZERO EMISSION COMMITMENT

## NET ZERO EMISSION COMMITMENT

## PT BIRO KLASIFIKASI INDONESIA (PERSERO)

As part of IDSurvey Group, engaged in the testing, inspection, certification, consulting, and classification (TICCC) sector, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) hereinafter referred as BKI views climate change not merely as a global challenge, but as an integral part of business responsibility that must be managed systematically and measurably. This commitment is increasingly relevant given BKI's role in supporting national industry through classification and certification services that contribute to the transition toward a low-carbon economy.

The Government of Indonesia, through Presidential Regulation No. 110 of 2025, has reaffirmed its national policy direction in reducing greenhouse gas emissions, as further elaborated in the Enhanced Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC). In line with this policy direction and Indonesia's national Net Zero Emission (NZE) target for 2060 or earlier, BKI affirms its commitment to actively contribute to the achievement of this target through the following measures:

1. Conducting active and continuous Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions inventories covering Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3, as the basis for accurate and accountable measurement of the Company's carbon footprint.
2. Developing a Net Zero Emission roadmap to be established simultaneously with all member entities of IDSurvey Group in 2027, in order to determine the base year, interim targets, and integrated decarbonization strategies across all emission scopes.
3. Actively implementing various emission reduction initiatives and programs across all of the Company's operational activities, as a concrete contribution toward achieving the Net Zero Emission target.

As part of strengthening its climate governance, BKI is also committed to studying and developing an internal carbon pricing mechanism as a strategic planning instrument for the Company. This mechanism will be used to support cost-benefit analysis, drive energy efficiency, guide the consideration of climate-related risks and opportunities in business decision-making, and serve as a reference for the Company's future low-carbon investment planning. The implementation of this internal carbon price will be developed progressively in line with the preparation of IDSurvey Group's Net Zero Emission roadmap in 2027.

title: BKI Strengthens Maritime Safety Partnerships at IYF 2026
full_text:
# BKI Strengthens Maritime Safety Partnerships at IYF 2026

BKI strengthened partnerships with key maritime stakeholders at IYF 2026 through a series of MoUs focused on improving safety, seaworthiness, and maritime risk management in Indonesia's tourism shipping sector.

Benoa, August 8, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero), or BKI, strengthened its collaboration with key maritime industry stakeholders by signing a series of Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) to support the development of Indonesia's leisure and maritime tourism sector. The agreements were signed during the INSA Yacht Festival (IYF) 2026 in Benoa, Bali.

![DSC07137.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_07137_9e9e981df1.JPG)

BKI signed MoUs with the Indonesian National Shipowners' Association (INSA), PT Jasaraharja Putera, and PT Reasuransi Indonesia Utama (Persero) to promote the development of the maritime tourism industry, with a focus on strengthening safety standards, technical seaworthiness, and maritime risk management.

The agreements were signed by BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto, PT Jasaraharja Putera President Director Abdul Haris, INSA Chairperson Carmelita Hartoto, and PT Reasuransi Indonesia Utama (Persero) Technical Director Delil Khairat.

BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto emphasised that strengthening maritime safety and classification standards requires close collaboration among industry stakeholders.

“Through collaboration with all stakeholders, BKI is optimistic that strengthening classification functions and safety standards will make a tangible contribution to creating a safer, more efficient, and sustainable maritime tourism sector, while simultaneously reinforcing Indonesia's position as a competitive maritime nation on the global stage,” said Benny.

As part of the same event, BKI also signed MoUs with PT Tringgading Agung Pratama, PT Wisata Biru Indonesia, and PT Pelayaran Wisata Laut Varuna Sakti. These partnerships are aimed at supporting the development of the maritime tourism sector while strengthening safety and reliability across tourism-related shipping activities.

Through these multi-stakeholder partnerships, BKI is reinforcing the implementation of safety standards across the leisure shipping industry. The initiative is expected to support safer and more reliable maritime tourism activities while contributing to the sustainable growth of Indonesia's maritime tourism sector.

# Lewat Safety Workshop Kapal Penyeberangan, PT BKI (Persero) Tingkatkan Keselamatan Pelayaran

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)/BKI menggelar Safety Workshop Kapal Penyeberangan pada 8 Agustus 2025 di Banyuwangi untuk meningkatkan keselamatan pelayaran, khususnya lintasan Ketapang–Gilimanuk.

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI melakukan langkah-langkah strategis untuk meningkatkan keselamatan penumpang kapal di seluruh Indonesia, khususnya pada penyeberangan Ketapang-Gilimanuk dengan menggelar Safety Workshop Kapal Penyeberangan pada Jum’at, 8 Agustus 2025 di Illira hotel, Banyuwangi.

Dalam kegiatan ini dihadiri langsung oleh Direktur PT BKI (Persero), R. Agus Doddy D, Direktur PT BKI (Persero), Arief Budi P, Kepala Cabang Utama Klas BKI Surabaya, Bambang Riyanto, Ketua KNKT, Suryanto Cahyono, Kepala KSOP Tanjung Wangi, Kapten Purgana, Kepala UPP Gilimanuk, M.Mustajib, Kepala Korsatpel Ketapang, Bayu Kusumo N, Ketua Umum GAPASDAB, Khoiri Soetomo, Ketua DPC GAPASDAP Banyuwangi, Nurjatim, Ketua Infa Ketapang, Arselan, dan Perwakilan Perusahaan Pelayaran serta Perwira Kapal.

Diskusi ini digelar untuk mencari solusi konkret demi memperkuat sistem keselamatan pelayaran. Termasuk membangun kesadaran kolektif akan pentingnya profesionalisme dan kepatuhan dalam operasional kapal penyeberangan serta dengan adanya workshop ini sebagai langkah perbaikan dan kolaborasi, kewaspadaan pemilik kapal hingga kru yang memahami kondisi kapalnya dapat ditingkatkan.

Di kegiatan ini juga para peserta mendapatkan berbagai materi meliputi materi live saving appliances dan cargo securing lashing, materi stability booklet dan case study cara pembacaan, serta materi studi kasus dan safety awareness, oleh sebabitu Workshop ini mendapatkan antusiasme tinggi dari para pelaku penyeberangan lintas Ketapang-Gilimanuk dengan tingkat kehadiran lebih dari 100 persen.

Harapan kami, dengan adanya kolaborasi ini safety itu bisa kita tingkatkan bersama. Arief Budi P juga menambahkan, mengapa klasifikasi dan sertifikasi kapal menjadi kunci utama dalam mendukung tema “Aman Menyebrang, Nyaman Bepergian” bahwa klasifikasi dan pemastian merupakan salah satu prinsip dasar dari keselamatan pelayaran karena dalam proses sertifikasi, BKI menetapkan batasan-batasan teknis seperti kapasitas muatan maksimum, dimensi kapal, hingga kelengkapan instrumen keselamatan serta operator diwajibkan mematuhi semua ketentuan tersebut.

title: PT BKI (Persero) and the Ministry of Transportation Hold Seminar: The Fundamental of Ship Recycling
full_text:
# PT BKI (Persero) and the Ministry of Transportation Hold Seminar: The Fundamental of Ship Recycling

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (“BKI”), as the lead of the State-Owned Enterprises (SOEs) Survey Services Holding, in collaboration with the Directorate General of Sea Transportation, organized a seminar

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (“BKI”), as the lead of the State-Owned Enterprises (SOEs) Survey Services Holding, in collaboration with the Directorate General of Sea Transportation, organized a seminar titled “The Fundamental of Ship Recycling.” The event aimed to educate shipowners and shipyards on ship recycling practices in accordance with international regulations, while also introducing BKI’s innovative classification and consultancy services. The seminar was held on Tuesday, January 14, 2025, at Hotel Borobudur, Jakarta.

The event was attended by the Director of Shipping and Maritime Affairs, Ministry of Transportation of the Republic of Indonesia, Capt. Hendri Ginting, represented by Head of Sub-Directorate PMKK, Dr. Capt. Miftakhul Hadi, S.ST, MM, M.Mar.; BKI’s Director of Operations, Mr. R. Benny Susanto, represented by Deputy Director of Classification Business Management, Mr. Arief Budi Permana; as well as representatives from BP Batam, INSA, IPERINDO, BSOA, IISIA, government agencies, associations, and BKI’s clients.

In his remarks, BKI’s Director of Operations, Mr. R. Benny Susanto—represented by Mr. Arief Budi Permana—emphasized the importance of understanding ship recycling regulations, particularly with the enforcement of the IMO Hong Kong Convention on June 26, 2025, which will mark a global milestone in ensuring safe, sustainable, and environmentally friendly ship recycling processes.

“Why is this important? Because any vessel that fails to comply with the requirements of this convention risks detention when calling at ports of countries that have already adopted the regulation. As a company committed to supporting Indonesia’s maritime industry, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) has developed Ship Recycling services to assist companies in meeting these requirements through the issuance of a Statement of Compliance (SoC),” he stated.

Through this seminar, BKI seeks not only to provide knowledge but also to open opportunities for collaboration. A two-day follow-up training program will also be conducted at BKI’s Head Office in Jakarta.

title: BKI Participates in FIA UI Community Service Programme in Batam
full_text:
# BKI Participates in FIA UI Community Service Programme in Batam

BKI participated in a community service programme organised by FIA UI and PT Pegaunihan Technology Indonesia in Batam, focusing on the relationship between employee well-being and workplace performance.

**Batam, September 19, 2026 –** PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero), or BKI, participated in a community service programme organised by lecturers from the Faculty of Administrative Sciences at Universitas Indonesia (FIA UI) in collaboration with PT Pegaunihan Technology Indonesia in Batam, Riau Islands. Held under the theme “Well-Being and Performance at Work: Enhancing Employee Well-Being to Support Individual and Corporate Performance,” the programme brought together around 50 employees from various divisions of PT Pegaunihan Technology Indonesia to explore the relationship between employee well-being and workplace performance.

As part of the programme, BKI Vice President of Human Capital Abdur Rahman delivered a session titled “Financial Wellbeing, Healthy Finance, Better Focus at Work.” The session examined how personal financial management can affect employee well-being and help individuals maintain focus in carrying out their responsibilities at work.

The programme also included discussions and question-and-answer sessions, personal action planning, and an evaluation. These activities encouraged participants to connect concepts such as employee engagement, work-life balance, and financial well-being with practical approaches that can be applied in their daily lives and workplace.

Abdur Rahman highlighted the importance of combining an understanding of personal finances with healthy habits that help employees manage priorities and maintain balance in their daily lives.

“Financial well-being is not merely about managing income and expenses; it is also about building healthy financial habits that allow individuals to carry out their activities and responsibilities with greater composure and focus,” said Rahman.

The programme provided a platform for collaboration between academia and industry, connecting academic knowledge with practical workplace needs. Through the involvement of BKI, FIA UI, and PT Pegaunihan Technology Indonesia, the initiative also contributed to knowledge sharing on human capital development, with a focus on employee well-being, productivity, and sustainable workplace practices.
